title.rendered: Magic Mouse 3: What to expect and when does it come out

content.rendered:
Apple’s Magic Mouse is infamous for its ergonomics, especially its charging port location. While the mouse has largely remained unchanged for over a decade except for the introduction of the USB-C port, a major redesign could finally be around the corner.

Yes, reports suggest that Apple is working on the Magic Mouse 3, focusing on fixing the most persistent flaws and making it more ergonomic. Here’s what to expect from the next-generation Magic Mouse and when it might be released.

A relocated charging port

Even though Apple switched from Lightning to the industry-standard USB-C port on the current version of Magic Mouse last year, the biggest issue with the charging port still exists. For those unaware, it’s the awful placement of the charging port at the bottom of the mouse, which prevents it from being used while charging.

According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurnam, Apple is said to be working on a redesigned Magic Mouse and will finally relocate the charging port to another location. While the exact placement remains unknown, Apple could opt for a front-facing port, similar to something found on the popular wireless mouse options like the Logitech MX Master 3S currently available in the market.

A more ergonomic design

Besides relocating the charging port, Apple is also said to be fixing Magic Mouse’s uncomfortable design. Although the current minimalistic and sleek design gives the mouse a clean look, users often criticize it for being too flat and uncomfortable for extended use. It’ll be great if Apple takes inspiration from other ergonomic mice by adding a more contoured shape, thumb rest, or improved grip.

While specific design changes are yet to be revealed, the redesign will be the most significant change to the Magic Mouse since its introduction in 2009. Over the years, Apple made a few changes, such as switching from AA batteries to a built-in rechargeable battery in 2015 and introducing new color options in 2021. However, a full-fledged redesign is long overdue.

Will there be additional features?

A while back, there was a rumor that the Magic Mouse 3 would incorporate voice control, but this speculation turned out false. Currently, there are no rumors or leaks about what the new Magic Mouse will offer. However, we expect Apple to introduce improved tracking technology, haptic feedback, or Force Touch enhancements if the tech giant wants to make the Magic Mouse more a promising offering.

Apple Magic Mouse 3: Release date and pricing

Don’t expect the Magic Mouse 3 anytime soon, as Gurman suggests it won’t launch until 2026. Apple has a reputation for updating its peripherals infrequently, so this timeline isn’t too surprising.

As for pricing, the current Magic Mouse is available for $79 as a standalone purchase and is bundled at no extra cost with the iMac and Mac Pro. It’s unclear if Apple will raise the price with the new model. However, as has been the case in the past, the Cupertino tech giant could raise the price owing to a significant redesign and improved ergonomics.

Summing up…

The Magic Mouse has been a staple of the Apple ecosystem for iMac and Mac computer users since 2009, though it has lagged in terms of design and usability. But if the rumors turn out to be true, the relocated charging port and a much-needed ergonomic redesign of the Magic Mouse 3 could finally address long-standing frustrations. We must all wait until 2026 to see what Apple will offer.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting a backup delete data from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Backups are stored locally on your Mac or PC. Deleting them won’t affect the data on your iPhone.

mainEntity.name: How can I check backup size on Mac or PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Finder or iTunes, click Manage Backups → hover over a backup to view its size and date.

mainEntity.name: Can I move iPhone backups to an external drive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Copy the backup folder to your external drive and create a symbolic link pointing to it in your original Backup directory.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I delete all backups?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll lose restore points. Always ensure you have one working backup — either on iCloud or locally - before deleting.

mainEntity.name: Does Low Data Mode save battery on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Low Data Mode can help save battery on your iPhone by pausing background activities that consume power.

mainEntity.name: What apps are affected by Low Data Mode on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, apps that rely on background data, such as email and messaging apps, are affected by Low Data Mode.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change my Snapchat username?

acceptedAnswer.text: You may not be able to change your Snapchat username because you have already updated it within the past year, or there may be a temporary issue with Snapchat’s servers.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to change my Snapchat username without waiting a year?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Snapchat enforces a strict one-year limit on username changes. The only way to get a different username before then is to create a new Snapchat account.

mainEntity.name: Can I reuse an old Snapchat username?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, once a username has been changed or an account has been deleted, the old username cannot be reclaimed.

mainEntity.name: How can I export my slideshow as a video?

acceptedAnswer.text: To export a slideshow created in the Keynote app as a video, Click on File → Export → Movie.

mainEntity.name: How do I share my slideshow with others?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simply click the Share button in either the Photos or Keynote app to share the slideshow with others.

mainEntity.name: How can I delete slideshows?

acceptedAnswer.text: To delete a slideshow created in the Keynote app, open the Keynote app → Drag and drop the slideshow file in the Trash.

title.rendered: Top 10+ iOS 18.4 features you need to check out

content.rendered:
Apple’s iOS 18 update is incredibly noteworthy as it introduced many significant features (like Apple Intelligence) and overhauls to native apps. Naturally, iOS 18.4 is also no exception. In this article, I’ll share the top 10+ features of the iOS 18.4 update, its compatible devices, and how to prepare your iPhone for the update.

iOS 18.4 release date

Apple finally launched the official iOS 18.4 update on March 31st, 2025, with many new features. However, the expected personalized Siri features are not included.

All the latest features in iOS 18.4

With each iOS update, Apple aims to enhance user experience through performance improvements, new features, and security updates.

Here’s what you get in the latest iOS 18.4 update.

1. Priority notifications

To help you manage alerts more effectively, iOS 18.4 introduced Priority Notifications. Apple Intelligence already shows priority emails in the Mail app. It will use the same functionality to analyze your notifications and highlight the most important ones at the top of your list. So, you would never miss critical updates. Combined with Notification Summaries, this can boost your productivity.

2. New emojis

iOS 18.4 introduces a fresh batch of emojis, adding more diversity and creative expression options. This update includes eight new emojis such as:

  • Face with bags under eyes
  • Fingerprint
  • Leafless tree
  • Root vegetable
  • Harp
  • Shovel
  • Splatter
  • Flag of Sark

3. New image styles in Image Playground

The Image Playground app also received an update with iOS 18.4. Apple added a new Sketch style in addition to the existing Animation and Illustration styles, enabling you to generate images with a hand-drawn appearance. If you’re wondering how Sketch style would work, you may use the Image Wand in Notes to get an idea.

4. Apple Vision Pro app on iPhone

With iOS 18.4, Apple officially rolled out a new Apple Vision Pro app for the iPhone. This app makes it easier to manage and use the Vision Pro headset without always putting it on.

You can find your Vision Pro’s model number, software version, and serial number in the app. Apple also promised to provide tips and updates about Vision Pro’s latest features. Moreover, you may explore new video content, apps, and games for Vision Pro directly from your iPhone.

5. Apple Intelligence in more languages

The iOS 18.4 update included new language support in Apple Intelligence, such as French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (simplified), and localized English for Singapore and India. So you can now enjoy the features in your native language.

Starting in April, Apple will extend its Apple Intelligence features to users in the European Union. This expansion will allow more users to benefit from the latest AI-driven functionalities. If you can’t access the AI features right now, worry not. There’s an easy trick to use Apple Intelligence outside the U.S. that you can use to get them on your iPhone.

6. Food section in Apple News+

Another feature I am excited about is the new Food section for Apple News+ subscribers in iOS 18.4. It offers several recipes from top food publishers, including Allrecipes, Bon Appétit, Food & Wine, Good Food, and Serious Eats. The new Recipe Catalog section features new recipes regularly.

Apple News editors also included curated stories about restaurants, healthy eating, and kitchen essentials. A notable addition is the cook mode, which presents step-by-step instructions in a full-screen format. So, you can use it easily during cooking. While primarily for subscribers, select recipes and stories are expected to be accessible to non-subscribers as well.

7. Ambient Music in the Control Center

Control Center got a new Ambient Music feature in iOS 18.4. It offers quick access to curated soundscapes designed to enhance your well-being and productivity. Right now, you can find four distinct categories with instrumental playlists, such as:

Sleep

  • Sleep Sounds
  • Bedtime Beats
  • Sound Bath
  • Piano Sleep

Chill

  • Piano Chill
  • Ambient Chill
  • Lo-Fi Jazz
  • Pure Chill

Productivity

  • BEATStrumentals
  • Binaural Frequencies
  • Pure Focus
  • Classical Concentration

Wellbeing

  • Pure Calm
  • Pure Meditation
  • Spa
  • Beats & Breath

You may select any category to add as a tile in the Control Center. Tapping the control will start a random sound or music from that category. If you want to skip the track or see what music is playing, you need to access Dynamic Island. Apple also adds the playback control in the Control Center, like the Music app.

The update also introduced a new Apple Intelligence & Siri section in the Control Center. It has Talk to Siri, Type to Siri, and Visual Intelligence controls. Therefore, if you have an iPhone 16e or 15 Pro, you can easily access Visual Intelligence features directly from the Control Center.

8. App review summaries in the App Store

To help users quickly understand the general opinion about an app, Apple introduced Apple Intelligence-generated review summaries. These summaries condense user feedback into brief paragraphs, highlighting key insights from reviews.

When you go to the Ratings & Reviews section of an app or game in the App Store, you’ll see a review summary. Additionally, these summaries are updated at least weekly to reflect new user feedback.

This feature will initially be available in the US App Store for apps and games published in English that have accumulated a sufficient number of reviews.

9. Pause app downloads and updates

You may know that you cannot temporarily stop downloading an app or an update. The only option is to cancel the download entirely and restart it from the beginning later.

Apple has finally added a pause button that allows users to temporarily halt an app or update a download so they may resume it later without losing progress. This feature is super useful when you have poor connectivity or network congestion.

10. Changes in the Photos app

iOS 18.4 also brought six key improvements to the Photos app, making it easier to manage and organize pictures. You can filter photos or videos by Shared With You (items received from others) and Not in an Album (unorganized photos).

In the Albums tab, a new Sort by Date Modified feature allows albums and folders to be arranged based on recent changes. Moreover, iOS 18.4 added a toggle to hide the Recently Viewed and Recently Shared albums for more privacy.

Lastly, if you have enabled Use Face ID in Photos settings, you can’t import your hidden photos to your Mac or PC. This enhances your privacy.

11. EV Routing updates in Maps

In iOS 18.4, Apple updated the Apple Maps EV routing feature to support a broader range of charging stations, including Tesla’s North American Charging Standard (NACS) Superchargers. This update is particularly beneficial for Ford Mustang Mach-E and F-150 Lightning owners who use CarPlay, as they can now be routed to NACS chargers when planning their trips.

Previously, Apple Maps EV routing was limited to Combined Charging System (CCS) stations, even after manufacturers like Ford provided adapters for NACS compatibility. With iOS 18.4, Apple Maps recognizes vehicles equipped with NACS adapters and includes these charging stations in route planning.

Other note-worthy features in iOS 18.4

Along with the major changes, iOS 18.4 also packs some minor yet useful upgrades in the native apps. Now, when you start a new search in Safari, the recent search recommendations allow you to swiftly return to earlier queries.

The Screen Time restrictions got more strict. If you have put an App Limit on an app, deleting and reinstalling it doesn’t remove the restriction.

Additionally, new podcast widgets include a Library widget to access your most frequently used playlists, such as Latest Episodes, Saved, and Downloaded. There’s also a Followed Shows widget to keep track of your favorite shows.

With iOS 18.4, you can now control and automate your Matter-compatible robot vacuum cleaners from the Home app.

Which iPhone models support iOS 18.4?

Apple strives to support a wide range of devices with its updates. However, older models may eventually lose compatibility due to hardware limitations. This time, iOS 18.4 rolled out on iPhone XR and newer, the same as the iOS 18 supported device list.

Devices older than these may not support iOS 18.4. To check your device model, go to Settings → General → About.

How to prepare for the iOS 18.4 update

New iOS updates often pack bugs and glitches. So, before you start the update process, safeguard your data by backing up your device. You can accomplish this through iCloud or a computer (PC or Mac).

Additionally, you need ample storage on your iPhone to download the update. So check your storage under Settings → General → iPhone Storage and delete any unused apps or files, if needed, to free up space on your iPhone.

Finally, when updating, make sure your device has at least 50% battery or is plugged into a charger. When the iOS 18.4 download is available, go to Settings → General → Software Update and hit Install Now.

If the update is not appearing, check that your device is compatible and connected to the internet. In case the installation fails, restart your device and try again, or consider updating via a computer. Otherwise, you can try some fixes if you are unable to download the iOS update on your iPhone.

Signing off

With so many long-requested features, iOS 18.4 is indeed an exciting update. However, we are still waiting for the anticipated on-screen awareness and personal context for Siri. Apple may finally introduce those in the upcoming iOS update in June.

Which features are you waiting for? Let me know in the comments below!

Don’t miss these:

  • The iPhone 16e is missing these 10 features
  • iPhone 16e vs. iPhone 16: All the differences explained
  • iOS 18.5: New features and release date

mainEntity.name: Does deleting a backup delete data from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Backups are stored locally on your Mac or PC. Deleting them won’t affect the data on your iPhone.

mainEntity.name: How can I check backup size on Mac or PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Finder or iTunes, click Manage Backups → hover over a backup to view its size and date.

mainEntity.name: Can I move iPhone backups to an external drive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Copy the backup folder to your external drive and create a symbolic link pointing to it in your original Backup directory.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I delete all backups?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll lose restore points. Always ensure you have one working backup — either on iCloud or locally - before deleting.

mainEntity.name: Does Low Data Mode save battery on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Low Data Mode can help save battery on your iPhone by pausing background activities that consume power.

mainEntity.name: What apps are affected by Low Data Mode on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, apps that rely on background data, such as email and messaging apps, are affected by Low Data Mode.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change my Snapchat username?

acceptedAnswer.text: You may not be able to change your Snapchat username because you have already updated it within the past year, or there may be a temporary issue with Snapchat’s servers.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to change my Snapchat username without waiting a year?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Snapchat enforces a strict one-year limit on username changes. The only way to get a different username before then is to create a new Snapchat account.

mainEntity.name: Can I reuse an old Snapchat username?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, once a username has been changed or an account has been deleted, the old username cannot be reclaimed.

acceptedAnswer.text: To export a slideshow created in the Keynote app as a video, Click on File → Export → Movie.

mainEntity.name: How do I share my slideshow with others?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simply click the Share button in either the Photos or Keynote app to share the slideshow with others.

title.rendered: How to pin notes in the Apple Notes app

content.rendered:
Apple Notes offers a convenient way to jot down important thoughts, ideas, or anything you want to remember. But imagine the frustration of not finding a note you took earlier when you need it most.

Thankfully, the Apple Notes app offers an easy tool to organize your notes and keep the most important ones at the top so you can get to them faster. Keep reading to learn how to ping a note in the Apple Notes app on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

What does pinning a note do in Apple Notes?

Pinning is a great way to improve the accessibility of your frequently needed notes in Apple Notes. When you pin a note, it moves to the Pinned section at the top of your notes list in the app. As a result, every time you open the app, you can access it directly without needing to find it.

Similar to other notes, pinned notes are visible across all your Apple devices. This means a note you pin on your iPhone will appear under the Pinned section on your iPad and Mac, too.

How to pin notes in Apple Notes

Pinning notes makes organization easy if you have a long list of notes. Here’s how to pin your notes in the Apple Notes app on an iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

On iPhone and iPad

  1. Go to the Apple Notes app and open the note you want to pin.
  2. Tap the three dots in the top-right corner and select the Pin option.

Alternatively, there are a couple more ways to pin a note in the Notes app on your iPhone. Long-press on the note you want to pin and select Pin Note. Or swipe right on the note you want to pin and tap the pin icon on the left side.

Go back to the folder by tapping the arrow in the upper-left corner, and you should see the pinned note under the Pinned section.

On Mac

  1. Open the Notes app.
  2. Control-click on the note that you wish to pin and select Pin Note.

Alternatively, you can also pin a note like this:

  1. Click on the note you want to pin to select it.
  2. Click File in the menu bar and choose Pin Note.

Your pinned note will be accessible from the Pinned section in the Notes app.

How to unpin notes in Apple Notes

If you don’t need to keep old notes you no longer need pinned in the Notes app, you can simply unpin then to declutter the Pinned section. Here’s how you do it on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

On iPhone and iPad

  1. In the Notes app, locate the note you want to unpin under the Pinned notes section.
  2. Open the note, tap the three dots in the top-right corner, and choose Unpin.

Alternatively, long-press on your pinned note and select Unpin Note. You can also just swipe right on the pinned note and select the unpin icon on the left side.

On Mac

  1. In Notes, locate the note under the Pinned section you want to unpin.
  2. Control-click on the note and select Unpin Note.

Alternatively, select the pinned note, click on File, and choose Unpin Note.

Wrapping up

Pinning notes in the Apple Notes App makes the organization of notes easy and helps you quickly check your most important notes. Your pinned notes will be synced across all your Apple devices if the Notes app has been enabled for your iCloud account.

FAQs

How do I pin a note to my iPhone Home Screen?

You can’t directly pin a note to your iPhone Home Screen. But you can add a widget of the Notes app to your Home Screen that shows your notes.

Can I pin notes inside a specific folder?

Yes, you can. Just open the folder in your Notes app and follow the same steps mentioned above to pin your notes within the folder.

Do pinned notes sync across devices?

Yes, your pinned notes will be synced across all your Apple devices connected to the same iCloud ID.

Can I pin a locked note?

Yes, you can pin a locked note as well. Just swipe right on your locked note and tap the pin icon.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting a backup delete data from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Backups are stored locally on your Mac or PC. Deleting them won’t affect the data on your iPhone.

mainEntity.name: How can I check backup size on Mac or PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Finder or iTunes, click Manage Backups → hover over a backup to view its size and date.

mainEntity.name: Can I move iPhone backups to an external drive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Copy the backup folder to your external drive and create a symbolic link pointing to it in your original Backup directory.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I delete all backups?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll lose restore points. Always ensure you have one working backup — either on iCloud or locally - before deleting.

acceptedAnswer.text: You may not be able to change your Snapchat username because you have already updated it within the past year, or there may be a temporary issue with Snapchat’s servers.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to change my Snapchat username without waiting a year?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Snapchat enforces a strict one-year limit on username changes. The only way to get a different username before then is to create a new Snapchat account.

mainEntity.name: How do I pin a note to my iPhone Home Screen?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can't directly pin a note to your iPhone Home Screen. But you can add a widget of the Notes app to your Home Screen that shows your notes.

mainEntity.name: Can I pin notes inside a specific folder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can. Just open the folder in your Notes app and follow the same steps mentioned above to pin your notes within the folder.

mainEntity.name: Do pinned notes sync across devices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, your pinned notes will be synced across all your Apple devices connected to the same iCloud ID.

title.rendered: How to set up cellular on your Apple Watch

content.rendered:
It would be unfair to think of the Apple Watch as just another smart wearable device. If you have a cellular Apple Watch model, it’s a full-fledged mini iPhone that keeps you connected even when you’re away from your iPhone. You can make calls, send and receive messages, stream music, and more—all while your paired iPhone stays at home.

However, to use these features, you must first set up a cellular plan on your Apple Watch, as it isn’t activated automatically. Keep reading to learn how.

Requirements for setting up cellular on Apple Watch

While the initial set up process for a cellular and GPS Apple Watch is similar, setting up cellular services requires you to meet the following requirements:

  • You must own an Apple Watch Series 3 (GPS + Cellular) or later that supports cellular connectivity. There are several ways to identify which Apple Watch model you have.
  • The paired iPhone must be an iPhone 8 or newer and run the latest available iOS.
  • Ensure your carrier supports cellular service for the Apple Watch.
  • Cellular Apple Watches use an eSIM, so no physical SIM card is required.
  • The iPhone should be connected to Wi-Fi or cellular data during set up.

How to set up cellular on Apple Watch

Once you meet the requirements, you can move ahead with the set up process:

  1. Press and hold the Side button on the Apple Watch until the Apple logo appears on the screen.
  2. Now, hold your Apple Watch near your iPhone and tap the Continue button on the “Use your iPhone to set up this Apple Watch” pop-up message that appears.
  3. Next, follow the on-screen instructions to pair and set up your Apple Watch.
  4. During the set up process, the Watch app will ask you whether you want to set up mobile on your Apple Watch. Follow the instructions to do so.
  5. Alternatively, you can set up cellular later via the Watch app.

Use the Watch app to set up cellular on your Apple Watch

  1. Open the Watch app on the paired iPhone and make sure you are on the My Watch tab.
  2. Here, locate and tap on Cellular.
  3. Now, if your mobile carrier account is eligible to enable cellular on your Apple Watch, tap the Set Up Cellular button. If not, the button will be greyed out.

  4. Next, tap Set Up Cellular again and follow the on-screen instructions to sign in to your carrier account and activate cellular service.

Note Your carrier may require additional verification or plan selection.

How to check if cellular is active on your Apple Watch

To conserve battery life, Apple has designed the Apple Watch to automatically switch to the most power-efficient wireless network. This means that if your paired iPhone is nearby, the Apple Watch will connect to it. Otherwise, it will connect to a Wi-Fi network if available, rather than unnecessarily draining the battery by staying on the cellular network.

Here’s how to check whether your Apple Watch is connected to a cellular network or your paired iPhone:

  1. Press the Side button to access the Control Center on your Apple Watch.
  2. If the Cellular icon is green, the Apple Watch is connected to the cellular network, and green bars at the top center represent the signal strength.
  3. If the Cellular icon is white, and a mobile icon appears at the top center, the Apple Watch is connected to the paired iPhone as it’s nearby.
  4. You can manually enable or disable cellular on your Apple Watch by tapping the Cellular button on the Control Center.

Manage cellular data on Apple Watch and tips to avoid extra costs

No one can deny the convenience of using cellular data on an Apple Watch, but managing it effectively is essential to avoid unnecessary charges. Here’s how:

Monitor data usage

  1. Open the Watch app on the paired iPhone.
  2. Tap on Cellular.
  3. Check your data consumption under the Mobile Data Usage section.

Reduce data consumption

While the Apple Watch automatically prefers switching to Wi-Fi if available, you can manually disable cellular in the Control Center when you don’t need it to save unnecessary data consumption.

Save money

  • Some carriers offer dedicated Apple Watch plans; check them to find the most cost-effective one.
  • If you travel frequently, confirm whether international roaming is included in your plan.
  • Streaming music or podcasts over cellular can consume a lot of data. Download content over Wi-Fi instead.

Remove your mobile plan

If, for whatever reason, you no longer wish to use cellular on your Apple Watch, you can remove your mobile plan easily. Here’s how:

  1. Open the Watch app and tap on Cellular.
  2. Here, tap the i button next to your carrier plan.
  3. Next, tap Remove [your mobile carrier name] plan.

Go iPhone free…

Setting up cellular connectivity on your Apple Watch adds a new level of convenience, allowing you to stay connected without carrying your iPhone everywhere. It can also help reduce screen time. However, be sure to monitor your data usage to avoid extra charges.

Have any questions? Drop them in the comments, and I’ll be happy to reply!

FAQs

Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn’t working on your Apple Watch.

Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular. 

Dear Apple Watch owner, here are some hacks you should know:

  • Things you can do on Apple Watch without iPhone
  • How to improve your Apple Watch battery life
  • Apple Watch too slow? Top tips to speed up your Apple Watch

mainEntity.name: Does deleting a backup delete data from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Backups are stored locally on your Mac or PC. Deleting them won’t affect the data on your iPhone.

mainEntity.name: How can I check backup size on Mac or PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Finder or iTunes, click Manage Backups → hover over a backup to view its size and date.

mainEntity.name: Can I move iPhone backups to an external drive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Copy the backup folder to your external drive and create a symbolic link pointing to it in your original Backup directory.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I delete all backups?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll lose restore points. Always ensure you have one working backup — either on iCloud or locally - before deleting.

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

title.rendered: Best iPhone car accessories for a smarter, safer drive!

content.rendered:
As an iPhone user, having the right accessories in your car can enhance convenience and improve your driving experience. Think of them as essential add-ons that complement your iPhone while you’re on the road.

So, if you’re wondering which accessories are must-haves, we’ve done the research for you. Here’s a roundup of the best car accessories in each category to help you make the perfect choice.

How to pick the right iPhone car accessories for your needs

We’ve rounded up the must-have car accessories in this blog based on firsthand user reviews from platforms like Reddit and Amazon. This follows our testing and research guidelines. However, since we’ve featured multiple products under each accessory category, you might wonder how to pick the right one for your car.

The first thing you should ask yourself is whether you truly need the accessory based on its features. Then, check if it’s compatible with your iPhone model and car type to avoid purchasing something that won’t work. For example, a MagSafe iPhone mount won’t be useful if you have an iPhone model older than the iPhone 12.

It’s also best to opt for MFi-certified accessories, as they’re more reliable and work seamlessly with iPhones. While we’ve already vetted the products in this article, checking user reviews and ratings can give you a clearer idea of what to expect. This also helps you understand the accessory’s features and whether they’re genuinely useful to you.

Lastly, consider your budget. There are plenty of affordable options that still offer great value, so choose accessories that fit your needs without overspending. Following these steps will help you make an informed decision and get the best accessories for your car.

Essential iPhone car accessories for convenience & safety

After thorough research, we’ve selected the best iPhone car accessories. Here’s a quick rundown of our top picks, highlighting their benefits and why you need them.

1. Car iPhone mounts & holders

Car iPhone mounts and holders are a smart investment, whether you use your iPhone frequently in the car or not. They help keep things organized while making navigation and hands-free calls much easier. Plus, they prop up your iPhone for quick access and even allow you to use it as a dash cam.

There are various types to choose from, including dashboard clips, windshield mounts, and magnetic holders that secure your iPhone without side clamps. Some even feature MagSafe charging to keep your phone powered on the go.

Here are our top picks to check out:

  1. ProClip USA: I’ve found this to be one of the best brands for custom car mounts. It offers options based on your car’s make, model, and year and supports a wide range of popular car brands. It ensures a sturdy mounting bracket that securely holds your iPhone in the best spot on the dashboard.

    Aside from regular iPhone holders, it also has magnetic and wireless charging mounts for those who need extra functionality. You can also browse mounts designed specifically for your iPhone model instead of choosing based on your car—perfect if you already know what will fit your dashboard.
  2. ESR for MagSafe Car Mount: This iPhone car mount gives a sturdy and flexible way to hold your iPhone in place with strong magnetic support. You can attach it to the dashboard, on top of your car’s touchscreen, behind it, or anywhere else with a flat surface.

    What I like most about it is its rotating feature, which lets you switch between portrait and landscape mode seamlessly. The arm also swivels and folds, giving you the flexibility to position your iPhone exactly how you need it. It’s compatible with iPhone models from the iPhone 12 to the iPhone 16.
  3. Belkin MagSafe Vent Mount Pro MagSafe iPhone Mount For Car: If you need a vent iPhone mount with MagSafe support, this Belkin mount is a great pick. It works with all MagSafe-compatible iPhones and locks securely onto most car air vents. What stands out is its ball joint, letting you rotate your iPhone 360 degrees and tilt it for the perfect viewing angle.

2. Car chargers & Wireless charging pads

To charge your iPhone on the go in your car, you’ll need either a wired charger or a wireless charging pad. Some car mounts even come with built-in wireless charging, and certain car models offer this feature as well. Additionally, some cars have a USB-A output, allowing you to plug in a cable for charging. Keep these options in mind when selecting a car charger. Also, remember that newer iPhone models now use USB-C instead of Lightning, so be sure to check the charger port before purchasing.

So here are some of the best car chargers you can use:

  1. Nekteck’s 45-watt charger: If you’re looking for a reliable wired charging solution for your iPhone in cars with a cigarette lighter, the Nekteck 45W USB-C Car Charger is a solid choice. This compact charger features a USB-C port and comes with a 1-meter USB-C to USB-C cable, delivering fast charging with a 45W maximum output. While iPhones typically charge at 18W, this charger still ensures efficient power delivery. It’s USB-IF certified for safety and also includes a smart USB-A port that automatically adjusts the charging speed for iPhones and iPads.
  2. Anker USB-C Car Charger: The Anker USB-C car charger stands out as one of the best options for iPhone users, praised for its durability and performance. With dual 20W USB-C ports, it delivers fast charging speeds. It supports PowerIQ 3.0, ensuring efficient, high-speed charging, and is compatible with iPhones, iPads, and other USB-C devices. Its ultra-compact design makes it easy to carry and use, providing convenience for on-the-go charging.
  3. BothLin Wireless Car Charger: If you’re looking for a reliable wireless charging solution for your car, this is our top pick. The BothLin Wireless Car Charger combines fast charging with a secure phone mount, making it easy to charge and use your phone while driving. It features auto-clamping and a 360° rotating mount to keep your phone steady and at the perfect angle for GPS. It offers 7.5W charging for iPhones. It’s also case-friendly and stays securely in place, even on bumpy roads.

3. Bluetooth & Audio adapters

If your car doesn’t have built-in Bluetooth support for its audio system or a wireless CarPlay connection, you’ll need either a Bluetooth adapter or a CarPlay adapter, depending on your needs. A Bluetooth adapter allows you to wirelessly connect your iPhone to your car’s audio system, even if it lacks native Bluetooth support.

On the other hand, a CarPlay adapter enables seamless iPhone integration with your car’s infotainment system, providing easy access to apps and features like navigation, music streaming, messaging, and hands-free calling directly from the display. These devices enhance your in-car experience, ensuring you get the most out of your iPhone while driving.

Here are a few examples of the products you can purchase for the functionalities:

  1. COMSOON Bluetooth Receiver for Car: If you want to add wireless audio to your non-Bluetooth car system, this is the product you need. It has a Bluetooth 5.0 chip for strong connections, quick transmission, and a wide signal range. It’s simple to use, and I find its intelligent noise-cancellation feature very useful—it makes calls in the car much clearer. It also comes with up to 16 hours of battery life and the ability to pair two devices at once.
  2. Ottocast U2-Air: This dongle is perfect for converting wired CarPlay to wireless CarPlay in your car. It connects seamlessly with your iPhone, giving you access to features like Siri, text reading, and more through your car’s infotainment system.
  3. VeoPulse Car Speakerphone ​B-Pro ‌2: This in-car speaker is perfect for anyone looking for clear audio while using their iPhone in the car. It’s easy to set up, connects automatically when you enter your car and delivers clean sound for making and receiving calls. Many users on platforms like Amazon have confirmed that it comes with a lasting battery.

4. Cable organizers & Multi-Port adapters

If you want a more organized car setup, cable organizers and multi-port adapters are essential. Cable organizers keep your charging cables neat and easy to grab, while multi-port adapters let you charge multiple devices at once. Together, they ensure your iPhone and other gadgets stay powered without the mess.

  1. TOLLEFE 5-in-1 USB Car Charger Multi Port: This car charger is perfect for charging multiple devices at once. It features 5 USB ports—3 on the adapter and 2 on an extended component for passengers in the back seat, keeping the car organized. Ideal for car trips with more than 3 people, this TOLLEFE charger supports charging 5 devices simultaneously at a maximum speed of 6.2A. The extended component also includes a back clip to help keep the car space neat.
  2. Adhesive Cable Clips: This accessory helps keep cables organized. It includes 60 super sticky and sturdy clips that reduce cluttered wires in your car.

5. Smart Dash Cams with iPhone Integration

Many drivers use dash cams for safety and recording. While some rely on their iPhone as a dash cam, dedicated dash cams that work with your iPhone offer a better experience. Here’s the best product we found in this category:

  • REDTIGER Dash Cam Front Rear: This is one of the best dash cams available. It offers 4K + 1080p dual recording, capturing all critical details on the road with clarity. It also features night vision and built-in GPS. You can manage the camera through a dedicated app on your iPhone, allowing you to view and playback recordings. However, it comes at a premium price.

Signing off…


When choosing iPhone accessories for your car, make sure to select products that suit your needs and budget. For example, if you’re looking for a car mount, decide whether you prefer one for the dashboard or one that clips onto the air vent.

Additionally, consider the other factors discussed in this guide to help you make the best choice. We hope this guide makes your decision easier and more straightforward.

mainEntity.name: Does deleting a backup delete data from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Backups are stored locally on your Mac or PC. Deleting them won’t affect the data on your iPhone.

mainEntity.name: How can I check backup size on Mac or PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Finder or iTunes, click Manage Backups → hover over a backup to view its size and date.

mainEntity.name: Can I move iPhone backups to an external drive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Copy the backup folder to your external drive and create a symbolic link pointing to it in your original Backup directory.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I delete all backups?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll lose restore points. Always ensure you have one working backup — either on iCloud or locally - before deleting.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I change my Snapchat username?

acceptedAnswer.text: You may not be able to change your Snapchat username because you have already updated it within the past year, or there may be a temporary issue with Snapchat’s servers.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to change my Snapchat username without waiting a year?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Snapchat enforces a strict one-year limit on username changes. The only way to get a different username before then is to create a new Snapchat account.

mainEntity.name: Can I reuse an old Snapchat username?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, once a username has been changed or an account has been deleted, the old username cannot be reclaimed.

mainEntity.name: How do I pin a note to my iPhone Home Screen?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can't directly pin a note to your iPhone Home Screen. But you can add a widget of the Notes app to your Home Screen that shows your notes.

mainEntity.name: Can I pin notes inside a specific folder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can. Just open the folder in your Notes app and follow the same steps mentioned above to pin your notes within the folder.

mainEntity.name: Do pinned notes sync across devices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, your pinned notes will be synced across all your Apple devices connected to the same iCloud ID.

mainEntity.name: Can I pin a locked note?

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

@graph.name: iGeeksBlog
@graph.description: iGeeksBlog is your global go-to source for Apple, tech, and gaming. Get the latest news, reviews, and tips to stay ahead in the fast-paced tech world.

@graph.name: ESR for MagSafe Car Mount
@graph.description: This iPhone car mount gives a sturdy and flexible way to hold your iPhone in place with strong magnetic support. You can attach it to the dashboard, on top of your car’s touchscreen, behind it, or anywhere else with a flat surface.

@graph.name: Belkin MagSafe Vent Mount Pro
@graph.description: If you need a vent iPhone mount with MagSafe support, this Belkin mount is a great pick. It works with all MagSafe-compatible iPhones and locks securely onto most car air vents. What stands out is its ball joint, letting you rotate your iPhone 360 degrees and tilt it for the perfect viewing angle.

@graph.name: Nekteck 45W Type C Car Charger
@graph.description: If you’re looking for a reliable wired charging solution for your iPhone in cars with a cigarette lighter, the Nekteck 45W USB-C Car Charger is a solid choice. This compact charger features a USB-C port and comes with a 1-meter USB-C to USB-C cable, delivering fast charging with a 45W maximum output.

@graph.name: Anker 40W 2-Port USB C Car Charger
@graph.description: The Anker USB-C car charger stands out as one of the best options for iPhone users, praised for its durability and performance. With dual 20W USB-C ports, it delivers fast charging speeds. It supports PowerIQ 3.0, ensuring efficient, high-speed charging, and is compatible with iPhones, iPads, and other USB-C devices.

@graph.name: BothLin Wireless Car Charger Phone Mount
@graph.description: The BothLin Wireless Car Charger combines fast charging with a secure phone mount, making it easy to charge and use your phone while driving. It features auto-clamping and a 360° rotating mount to keep your phone steady and at the perfect angle for GPS. It offers 7.5W charging for iPhones. It’s also case-friendly and stays securely in place, even on bumpy roads.

@graph.name: COMSOON Bluetooth Receiver for Car
@graph.description: It has a Bluetooth 5.0 chip for strong connections, quick transmission, and a wide signal range. It’s simple to use, and I find its intelligent noise-cancellation feature very useful—it makes calls in the car much clearer. It also comes with up to 16 hours of battery life and the ability to pair two devices at once.

@graph.name: OTTOCAST U2-AIR Wireless CarPlay Adapter
@graph.description: This dongle is perfect for converting wired CarPlay to wireless CarPlay in your car. It connects seamlessly with your iPhone, giving you access to features like Siri, text reading, and more through your car’s infotainment system.

@graph.name: VeoPulse Car Speakerphone B-Pro ‌2
@graph.description: This in-car speaker is perfect for anyone looking for clear audio while using their iPhone in the car. It’s easy to set up, connects automatically when you enter your car and delivers clean sound for making and receiving calls.

@graph.name: 60 PCS Adhesive Cable Clips
@graph.description: This accessory helps keep cables organized. It includes 60 super sticky and sturdy clips that reduce cluttered wires in your car.

@graph.name: REDTIGER 4K Dash Cam Front Rear
@graph.description: It offers 4K + 1080p dual recording, capturing all critical details on the road with clarity. It also features night vision and built-in GPS. You can manage the camera through a dedicated app on your iPhone, allowing you to view and playback recordings.

title.rendered: iPhone Repair Kits: What They Include and How to Choose the Right One

content.rendered:
iPhones have become more repair-friendly in recent years. However, the key to a successful iPhone repair is a proper repair kit—one that simplifies the repair experience by offering all the essential tools you need.

Keep reading to learn what an iPhone repair kit is and how to choose the right one for your device (and its repair requirements). We will also share some of the best iPhone repair kits you can currently buy.

Table of Contents
  • What is an iPhone repair kit?
  • Who should use an iPhone repair kit, and what are the risks of self-repairs?
  • How to choose the right iPhone repair kit
    • 1. Check for compatibility with your iPhone model
    • 2. Consider build and quality
    • 3. Look up reviews and recommendations
  • Best iPhone repair kits you can buy
    • Apple's Self Service Repair kit
    • Third-party iPhone repair kits

What is an iPhone repair kit?

An iPhone repair kit is a set of tools designed for repairing your iPhone. It typically includes screwdrivers, spudgers, suction cups, tweezers, and more. You can use these tools for various kinds of repairs, from simple repairs like battery replacements to more complex repairs, such as motherboard and screen replacements.

There are many repair kits available in the market. In fact, even Apple offers official repair kits tailored to each iPhone model, which is the safest and most recommended way to procure a compatible kit for iPhone’s repair. Alternatively, you may buy third-party iPhone repair kits, which typically come at a lower price.

Who should use an iPhone repair kit, and what are the risks of self-repairs?

Not everyone can pick up an iPhone repair kit and start fixing their device. You’ll need at least some knowledge of electronic systems in order to attempt a repair. If you’re unsure about any part of the repair process, it’s best to leave it to professionals.

However, in case you decide to take a leap, here are a few risks to keep in mind:

  • Damaging the internals: A small mistake can lead to irreparable damage to your device. So, always refer the manual thoroughly before you perform an action and be extra careful when dealing with fragile parts.
  • Voiding the warranty: Attempting to repair your iPhone yourself may void its warranty. Hence it’s advised to take matters into your hands only when your device is out of the warranty period.

How to choose the right iPhone repair kit

Choosing the right repair kit is crucial for a successful repair. With so many options available, here’s how to assess which is the right kit for your repair requirements.

1. Check for compatibility with your iPhone model

When choosing a repair kit, it’s essential to make sure that it’s compatible with your specific iPhone model. While iPhones may look similar externally, their internal structures vary, and so do the tools required to repair them. Using the wrong tools can lead to further damage.

For most iPhone repairs, you’ll need the following tools:

  1. Screwdrivers: Screwdrivers are the most important tool in any repair kit. Different iPhone models require different types of screws, but you’ll mostly need these:
    • Pentalobe screwdrivers: Pentalobe screws are the most common screw types on iPhones. They are flower-shaped and generally found around the iPhone’s exterior. You need a pentalobe screwdriver to remove them.
    • Tri-point screwdrivers: Most newer iPhone models use tri-point screws inside, so it’s essential to have this screwdriver for internal repairs.
    • Phillips head screwdrivers: Some components, like the motherboard, may require Phillips screws. As such, having a few different-sized Philips head screwdrivers is crucial.
  2. Suction cups: They help you remove the screen or back glass without damaging it. A strong suction cup can be especially helpful when working with glued or sealed parts.
  3. Plastic spudgers: These tools allow you to separate pressure-fit parts or adhesive-sealed components on your iPhone. For example, you may need them when you want to open the back case or lift delicate components from the chassis.
  4. Tweezers: Fine-point tweezers are necessary for handling small components, such as screws, connectors, and the battery.
  5. Anti-static wrist straps: One of the most important tools in a repair kit is the anti-static wrist strap. This tool helps prevent the build of static electricity in your body during repairs, as it can easily damage sensitive internal components when they come in contact. You definitely need it when you’re working with the motherboard and other internal circuits.
  • 33.99

2. Consider build and quality

The quality of the tools in the kit is vital. Kits with high-quality tools, such as magnetic screwdrivers, strong suction cups, and precision tools, can make the repair process much smoother and safer. High-quality tools also ensure that you don’t damage your iPhone’s delicate components during disassembly and reassembly.

When assessing a repair kit’s quality, consider the following:

  • Magnetic screwdrivers: These can help keep screws in place, reducing the risk of losing small components.
  • Ergonomic handles: Comfortable, non-slip handles can improve your grip, making it easier to perform repairs, especially on the tiny components of the iPhone.
  • Durability: Ensure the tools are sturdy and long-lasting, so you won’t need to replace them after a few repairs.

3. Look up reviews and recommendations

Always check user reviews before purchasing a repair kit. Most online retailers feature a review section where you can find feedback from other users. Be cautious of kits with a lot of suspiciously positive reviews or many negative ones. Look for reviews that talk specifically about the tool quality, ease of use, and accuracy of the instructions. Also, seek out recommendations from experienced users or repair professionals who can provide insight into which kits perform the best.

Best iPhone repair kits you can buy

There are multiple iPhone repair kits, available both online and offline, to choose from. Let’s look at a few popular ones and where to buy them.

Apple’s Self Service Repair kit

Apple launched its own Self Service Repair program a few years back, through which it provides consumers all the essential tools and parts, along with manuals to perform a successful repair. Visit Apple’s Self-Service Repair Store, select your iPhone model, and it will show you all the essential parts and tools you need to fix your iPhone.

Third-party iPhone repair kits

If you feel the tools offered by Apple are overkill or expensive, you can look at get a third-party iPhone repair kit. These are some of your options:

1. iFixit Tech Pro Kit: iFixit is a trusted name in the repair kit space, so you don’t have to worry about the quality of the tools. This Pro kit has all the tools required to perform all kinds of repairs on your iPhone. They also provide a 30-day return policy in case you don’t find the kit to your liking.

2. XOOL 200 in 1 Precision Kit: This is one of the highest-rated and most comprehensive tool kits on Amazon. The tools are made of CR-V steel through vulcanization, providing excellent hardness and durability. You also get a high-quality pouch-like design that makes storing and carrying the tools very easy.

3. STREBITO Electronics Precision Screwdriver Sets: These are among the highest-selling repair tools on Amazon and even have great reviews. They feature magnetic tools for precision handling and bits made of chrome-vanadium steel, providing long-lasting, high-quality repair gear for your iPhone.

Signing off

That’s pretty much all you need to know about iPhone repair kits, from what they are to what you should look for to find the correct set of tools for your repair needs. So go ahead, identify the problem with your iPhone and the kind of tools you’ll need to fix it and buy the appropriate tool kit.

Just as having the right repair kit, finding and picking genuine parts for your iPhone is equally important. So, be extra careful when ordering replacement parts and avoid non-trusted sellers.

acceptedAnswer.text: In Finder or iTunes, click Manage Backups → hover over a backup to view its size and date.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Copy the backup folder to your external drive and create a symbolic link pointing to it in your original Backup directory.

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll lose restore points. Always ensure you have one working backup — either on iCloud or locally - before deleting.

mainEntity.name: Can I pin notes inside a specific folder?

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

content.rendered:
For fans of the legendary anime and manga series Berserk, we’ve curated some of the best wallpapers to bring the dark fantasy and intense action of the series straight to your iPhone screen.

From epic battles to iconic characters like Guts and Skull Knight, these wallpapers capture the essence of Berserk—its raw power, struggle, and unrelenting spirit. Ready to Berserkify your iPhone? Check out the top picks below!

10 Stunning Berserk wallpapers for iPhone in 4k

I used a free website called 4Kwallpapers to find these stunning 4K Berserk wallpapers featuring Guts, Skull Knight, and iconic scenes from the legendary dark fantasy series. Download them below and change your wallpaper to match your mood.

1. The True Guts

This wallpaper captures Guts’ raw intensity, standing firm in his legendary black armor with the Dragon Slayer sword behind him. The blood-red backdrop and Japanese script enhance the dark aesthetic, making this a must-have for true Berserk fans.

Download

2. Guts “The Black Swordsman”

This piece perfectly embodies the dark fantasy nature of Berserk. The masked Guts, gripping his massive sword, with glowing red eyes, reflects his relentless pursuit of vengeance. If you love Berserk’s grim storytelling, this wallpaper is for you.

Download

3. Neon Guts

Love neon aesthetics? This wallpaper blends Guts’ fierce persona with a modern cyberpunk glow, adding an electrifying vibe to his iconic silhouette. A bold choice for those who enjoy vibrant yet dark-themed wallpapers.

Download

4. Guts in Berserker Armor

A shadowy and powerful depiction of Guts fully embracing his Berserker Armor. The intense red aura surrounding him showcases his uncontrollable rage and battle-driven spirit, making this wallpaper a striking addition to any iPhone screen.

Download

5. Starry Guts

This wallpaper showcases a rare, introspective moment—Guts gazing at the night sky, wrapped in deep thought. A departure from the usual action-heavy Berserk visuals, this one is perfect for a darker yet tranquil iPhone setup.

Download

6. Black & White Manga Guts

A dramatic black-and-white ink-style wallpaper that captures the essence of Kentaro Miura’s original manga art. This design emphasizes the raw emotions of Guts through high-contrast shading, bringing an authentic Berserk feel to your screen.

Download

7. Guts Fan Art Special

A unique, hand-drawn interpretation of Guts by an independent artist, offering a fresh and bold take on his fierce personality. This wallpaper is perfect for fans who appreciate original artwork while staying true to Berserk’s themes.

Download

8. The Skull Knight – The Timeless Warrior

A dark, haunting image of the mysterious Skull Knight, one of the most powerful and enigmatic figures in Berserk. The deep shadows and glowing red symbols give this wallpaper a menacing yet elegant presence—ideal for fans of the supernatural elements in Berserk.

Download

9. Guts Manga Sketch

A raw, hand-sketched drawing of Guts, reminiscent of the original pencil illustrations from the manga. If you’re a purist who loves classic anime/manga aesthetics, this wallpaper will be a perfect fit.

Download

10. The Berserk Theme

This minimalist wallpaper features the Brand of Sacrifice, a symbol of fate, suffering, and survival in the Berserk universe. The blood-red insignia against a dark backdrop captures the series’ brutal themes, making for a simple yet powerful home screen.

Download

Signing off

These wallpapers bring out the best of Berserk, from Guts’ ferocity to the haunting presence of Skull Knight. Whether you prefer high-contrast manga art, neon aesthetics, or minimalist symbols, there’s a perfect wallpaper here for you.

Which one is your favorite? Let us know in the comments! And if you love anime wallpapers, check out our exclusive The Invincible iPhone wallpapers for more epic designs!

title.rendered: How to add a printer to your Mac: Wired & wireless methods

content.rendered:
Just got a new printer? Congratulations! Printing documents is still essential, but before you start, you need to add the printer to your Mac. The good news? It’s easier than it looks! Whether your printer connects via USB, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or IP address, this guide will walk you through every method step by step.

How to connect a USB printer to your Mac

The oldest method of connecting devices is through a cable. Modern printers support both wired and wireless connections. If you want to connect your printer to your Mac via a USB, follow the below steps.  

  1. Set up your printer and ensure it is powered on.
  2. Connect it to your Mac using a USB cable.
  3. Wait for macOS to recognize the printer—it will automatically download the required software.
  4. If prompted, download and install the necessary drivers.
  5. If your MacBook lacks a USB port, use one of these best USB-C hubs for MacBook (insert link if available).

If your MacBook does not have a USB port, you can buy one of these USB-C hubs.

Troubleshooting USB printer issues

  • If your printer doesn’t appear, restart both your Mac and the printer, and check if the cable is properly connected.
  • Click the Apple logo, go to System Preferences (System Settings) → Printers & Scanners → + button and manually add the printer if needed.

How to add a wireless printer to your Mac

Printers sold today usually support Wireless pairing and printing. If your printer and Mac are connected to the same Wi-Fi network, chances are the printer might already be connected to your Mac. Otherwise, here’s how you can connect it:

  1. Ensure your printer and Mac are on the same Wi-Fi network.
  2. Click the Apple logo → Go to System Preferences (System Settings).

  3. Click Printer & Scanners.

  4. Click the + button to add a new printer.

  5. Select your printer from the list.
  6. If you see “AirPrint” next to “Use,” click Add.
  7. If AirPrint is missing, install the printer’s drivers manually from the manufacturer’s website.

If your printer is AirPrint-compatible but you cannot see AirPrint for it, here’s how to fix it.

How to add a printer via IP address

Use this method when your printer is on a network, but doesn’t appear automatically.

  1. Find your printer’s IP address (check printer settings or router admin panel).
  2. Click the Apple logo → System Preferences (System Settings).
  3. Select Printers & Scanners.
  4. Click the + button → select the IP icon (globe symbol).
  5. Enter your printer’s IP address in the “Address” field.
  6. Select the appropriate Protocol (AirPrint, IPP, LPD).
  7. Enter a Name & Location, then download the necessary drivers if prompted.
  8. Click Add to complete setup.

How to connect your Mac to a Bluetooth printer

Bluetooth printing can be slower and may not support all printers.

  1. Click the Apple logo → System Preferences (System Settings) → Printer & Scanners.
  2. Click the + button to add a printer.
  3. Select your Bluetooth-enabled printer from the list.
  4. Click Add, and wait for macOS to establish a connection.

Troubleshooting: Mac not connecting to a Bluetooth printer?

If your printer doesn’t appear, make sure:

  1. Bluetooth is turned on (System Preferences/System Settings → Bluetooth).
  2. Your printer is in pairing mode.
  3. Try removing and re-pairing the printer under Bluetooth settings.

Adding a Wi-Fi or mobile printer that requires a configuration profile

Some enterprise or mobile printers require special software to be discovered via AirPrint. If you’ve been provided with a configuration profile, install it as follows:

  1. Double-click the profile file (.mobileconfig) provided.
  2. Click Install when prompted.
  3. Confirm installation by clicking Install again.

Once installed, follow the Wi-Fi printer setup steps above.

How to set a default Printer on Mac

Setting a default printer saves time by automatically selecting it for all print jobs.

  1. Click the Apple Logo () → System Preferences (System Settings) → Printers & Scanners.
  2. Click the dropdown menu next to “Default Printer“.
  3. Select your preferred printer.

If you print in different locations, choose “Last Used Printer” to have macOS automatically remember the last printer you used at each location.

Wrapping up!

You can add printers to your Mac using these methods. If these methods do not work for you, let us know in the comments below, and we will do our best to help you.

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. title.rendered: How to connect your AirPods to Chromebook easily

content.rendered:
People often ask me, “Can AirPods connect to a Chromebook?” It’s a valid question, given that Apple focuses on creating a seamless ecosystem for its devices. However, despite their deep integration with iOS, AirPods are not exclusive to Apple products!

Thanks to Bluetooth connectivity, you can easily pair AirPods with a Chromebook, Windows laptop, Android phone, or any other Bluetooth-enabled device. If you’re having trouble connecting them, don’t worry—this step-by-step guide will walk you through the process. Keep reading!

How to connect AirPods to a Chromebook

Follow these simple steps to pair your AirPods with a Chromebook:

Step 1: Enable Bluetooth on your Chromebook

  1. Click the bottom-right corner of your Chromebook’s screen (on the clock).
  2. In the Quick Settings panel, click Bluetooth to turn it ON.
  3. Wait for your Chromebook to search for nearby devices.

Step 2: Put AirPods in pairing mode

  1. Place both AirPods inside their charging case and keep the lid open.
  2. Press and hold the setup button on the back of the case until the LED light flashes white.
  3. Your AirPods are now in pairing mode.

Step 3: Pair AirPods with your Chromebook

  1. On your Chromebook, go to Settings → Bluetooth.
  2. Look for AirPods in the list of available devices.
  3. Click on AirPods, then select Connect.
  4. Wait for the confirmation message that says “Connected”.

Step 4: Confirm connection and adjust settings

If you don’t hear sound through your AirPods, manually select them as your default audio output:

  1. Click the clock in the bottom-right corner.
  2. Select Audio Settings.
  3. Choose AirPods as the output device.

Your AirPods are now connected and ready to use!

How to disconnect or remove AirPods from Chromebook

If you want to disconnect or remove your AirPods from your Chromebook, follow these steps:

To disconnect:

  1. Turn off Bluetooth on your Chromebook or go to Settings → Bluetooth → Click on AirPods → Disconnect.

To remove (Forget) AirPods:

  1. Go to Settings → Bluetooth.
  2. Click on AirPods and select Forget device.

This will unpair your AirPods, and you’ll need to reconnect them manually next time.

That’s it! Your AirPods are now disconnected from your Chromebook. The next time you want to pair or connect, you will have to follow the steps mentioned in the beginning.

Watch a quick tutorial video by EggheadFixers

Signing off…

I hope this guide helped you successfully connect your AirPods to your Chromebook. If you have any questions, feel free to ask in the comments below! I’ll do my best to respond as soon as possible.

FAQs

Can I connect AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop?

Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

Can I name my AirPods on a Chromebook?

Unfortunately, you cannot change the name of your AirPods on a Chromebook. However, you can do so using your Apple device.

  • 10 Fixes for Perfect AirPods Balance

mainEntity.name: Does deleting a backup delete data from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Backups are stored locally on your Mac or PC. Deleting them won’t affect the data on your iPhone.

mainEntity.name: How can I check backup size on Mac or PC?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Finder or iTunes, click Manage Backups → hover over a backup to view its size and date.

mainEntity.name: Can I move iPhone backups to an external drive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Copy the backup folder to your external drive and create a symbolic link pointing to it in your original Backup directory.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I delete all backups?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll lose restore points. Always ensure you have one working backup — either on iCloud or locally - before deleting.

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. mainEntity.name: Can I connect AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.
