title.rendered: How to migrate purchases from one Apple Account to another Apple Account

content.rendered:
Apple solved a big issue that had been bugging quite a few users for a long time: the inability to migrate your Apple account purchases to another Apple Account. If you had purchased apps, subscriptions, music, videos, or other content from an Apple account, there was no way to move or transfer it to a different account. But not anymore, as Apple finally allows you to migrate purchases between your Apple Accounts. Let’s show you how to do it.

Table of Contents
  • Prerequisites to migrating purchases between Apple Accounts
  • How to migrate your purchases?
    • Set up a secondary account on your iPhone
  • Migrate your purchases between Apple Accounts
  • How to undo a migration
  • How to migrate purchases in unsupported regions

Prerequisites to migrating purchases between Apple Accounts

Before we list the prerequisites, there’s one thing you need to know: the Apple Account you are migrating to is the primary account, while the account you are migrating from is the secondary account.

With that out of the way, these are the requirements you must meet to migrate your purchases:

  • Primary and secondary accounts should be set to the same country and region.
  • You should have two-factor authentication enabled on both Apple Accounts.
  • You shouldn’t have any rentals or pre-orders on either of the accounts.
  • Make sure the secondary account is not part of any Family Sharing group.
  • Your last purchase should have been made at least 15 days ago (only for South Korea and Mainland China regions) 
  • Your secondary Apple Account shouldn’t be used with TestFlight to test beta versions of apps from a developer. You should turn it off in the TestFlight app before attempting migration.

Note: The migration feature is currently unavailable in the European Union, United Kingdom, and India.

How to migrate your purchases?

When all the prerequisites are met, you should log in to both Apple Accounts on your iPhone. The account you signed in to iCloud with is considered the primary account, and the account you have signed in to for media and purchases will be regarded as a secondary account by your iPhone.

Set up a secondary account on your iPhone

If you don’t have a secondary account set up on your iPhone, here’s what you need to do:

  1. Open Settings and tap your name at the top.
  2. Tap Media & Purchases and tap Sign Out to log out of the current account.

  3. After signing out, tap Media & Purchases again and tap Not ‘Your Name’? (Your Name here is the name that you have associated with your Apple Account, like in my case it says Not Geekified Blog?)
  4. Now, type in your secondary account details in the Email or Phone Number and Password fields and tap Continue.

You have successfully set up your secondary account.

Migrate your purchases between Apple Accounts

With both accounts set up, you are all set to transfer your purchases. Here are the steps you need to follow:

  1. Head to your Apple Account page in the Settings app.
  2. Select Media & Purchases and tap View Account.
  3. Scroll down and tap Migrate Purchases.

  4. When prompted for your Apple Account password, enter it.
  5. Now, on the Migrate Purchases screen, tap Continue and Continue again on the following screen.
  6. Check if you have the primary and secondary accounts set correctly and tap Migrate to start the migration process. (You will see the confirmation text, “Purchases Have Been Migrated,” on the screen when the migration is complete.)

  7. Sign out of the secondary Apple Account and sign back in to your primary Apple Account.

How to undo a migration

At any point, if you want to undo a migration, you can do it easily using the Undo Migration option. This is what you need to do:

  1. Go to your Apple Account details page in Settings.
  2. Tap Media & Purchases > View Account.
  3. Under Secondary Account, you will see an Undo Migration button. Tap it.
  4. Now, on the Undo Purchase Migration screen, tap Continue and tap Undo Migration in the following screen and confirm the choice when prompted.

You have reversed the migration process. All your purchases will now return to the secondary account.

Note If you undo migration, you won’t be able to migrate purchases again for one year.

How to migrate purchases in unsupported regions

As mentioned earlier, the migration feature is not supported in certain regions. But there is a workaround to get it working if you live in these countries. Here’s what it looks like:

  1. Head to your Apple Account page in Settings.
  2. Go to Media & Purchases > View Account.
  3. Tap Country & Region and tap Change Country or Region on the following screen.
  4. Now select any country except for the three unsupported ones.

  5. Tap Agree on the Terms & Conditions page to continue.
  6. Now, select None for payment details and for billing address, you can fill in dummy details.
  7. Tap Next to finish changing the region.

Now that you have changed the region, you can try the above steps to transfer your purchases.

Signing off…

The introduction of the purchase migration feature was absolutely needed. Now, you can use just one Apple Account for everything instead of juggling between accounts to access different things. The migration process is also relatively simple and straightforward, letting anyone use it with ease.

  • How to import passwords from other apps into new Apple Passwords
  • How to transfer WhatsApp data from Android to iPhone

title.rendered: Best Apple Watch Accessories for Ultimate Convenience

content.rendered:
Your Apple Watch is a powerhouse device that improves your life. But the right accessories can take your experience to the next level. Whether you want to protect your watch from wear and tear, ensure it never runs out of power, or simply add a touch of style, we’ve found the best Apple Watch accessories that are worth your while. Check them out below to upgrade your experience.

Table of Contents
  • 10 Best Apple Watch Accessories at a Glance
  • What to consider when choosing Apple Watch accessories
  • What we looked for in must-have Apple Watch accessories
    • 1. Best rugged case: amband Sport Series
    • 2. Best everyday protective case: Spigen Rugged Armor Pro
    • 3. Protective ultra slim case – Spigen ThinFit
    • 4. A classic leather band – NOMAD Traditional Band
    • 5. Designer band for women – Kate Spade New York Store
    • 6. Best portable charger: Native Union Voyage
    • 7. Best charging stand – Belkin
    • 8. Mini power bank – Anker MagGo
    • 9. Best carrying case: MoKo Storage Box
    • 10. Apple Watch bands wall mount- Twelve South TimePorter
  • Signing off

10 Best Apple Watch Accessories at a Glance

  1. Best Sporty Rugged Case with strap: amBand Sport Series
  2. Best everyday protective case with strap: Spigen Rugged Armor Pro
  3. Protective ultra-slim case: Spigen ThinFit
  4. Classic leather band: NOMAD Traditional Band
  5. Best designer band for women: Kate Spade New York Leather or Nylon Band
  6. Best portable charger: Native Union Voyage
  7. Best charging stand: Belkin 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station
  8. Mini power bank: Anker MagGo Compact Battery Pack
  9. Best carrying case: MOKO Storage Box
  10. Apple Watch bands wall mount: Twelve South TimePorter Wall Mount

What to consider when choosing Apple Watch accessories

When selecting Apple Watch accessories, ensure they meet your specific needs and preferences. Here are important factors to consider:

Apple Watch Compatibility: Not all accessories are compatible with every Apple Watch model. Always check the size and compatibility details before purchasing to ensure the band, case, or charger works seamlessly with your specific Apple Watch series and size (e.g., 41mm vs. 45mm).

Purpose and Use: Consider how and where you use your Apple Watch. If you’re into fitness, opt for a breathable, sweat-resistant band and a rugged case. For professional settings, a sleek leather or stainless steel band adds sophistication. Wireless chargers and stands enhance convenience for everyday use and travel.

Material & Build Quality: Durability and comfort are crucial. Silicone and nylon bands are lightweight and great for workouts, while metal and leather offer a premium feel for casual or business wear. Read about the materials used to make the accessory, ensuring durability and functionality.

Price: Apple Watch accessories range widely, from budget-friendly options to high-end designer pieces. While affordability is important, investing in slightly pricier but high-quality accessories ensures that they truly add some value to your life and last for a long time.

What we looked for in must-have Apple Watch accessories

At iGeeksBlog, we take every measure to recommend products that are truly worth it in terms of quality and price. We always opt for reputable brands that create trusted products. Moreover, our recommendations are based on our expert reviews.

We follow strict editorial guidelines to provide you with an objective, authentic opinion on the products we recommend. Moreover, we take the time to test products in depth before recommending them to you.

Therefore, you can rest assured that we have considered every important aspect when shortlisting the best Apple Watch accessories for you.

1. Best rugged case: amband Sport Series

If you’re looking for a rugged yet stylish Apple Watch case that offers superior protection without compromising comfort, the AMBAND Sport Series M1 is a great choice. It provides all-around protection with a raised bezel that shields your Apple Watch screen from accidental bumps and scratches.

Moreover, it’s lightweight, with clicky buttons and precise cutouts for seamless operation of your watch’s screen and crown.

You can choose from a range of color options. As a bonus, you can access exclusive watch faces by scanning the QR code on the packaging.

Compatibility: Fits Apple Watch Series 3-10, SE 1-2 (44mm, 45mm, 46mm)
Adjustable strap suits most wrist sizes (5.71″-8.74″)

Pros

  • Superior protection with raised bezels
  • Lightweight yet durable build
  • Comfortable for extended wear
  • Free exclusive watch faces

Cons

  • Bulky design

Price: $25.99

2. Best everyday protective case: Spigen Rugged Armor Pro

Spigen makes some of the best accessories for Apple Watch and other Apple devices. The Rugged Armor Pro case features a dual-layer construction combining flexible TPU and durable polycarbonate materials. This design provides a robust defense against shocks, drops, and scratches.

Moreover, it comes with an integrated adjustable wristband equipped with a secure metal clasp. This ensures a snug and comfortable fit, making it ideal for workouts and daily wear.

Compatibility: Fits Apple Watch Series 4-10 (44mm, 45mm, 46mm)
Adjustable strap suits most wrist sizes (5.5″-8.5″)

Pros

  • Comprehensive protection with dual-layer design
  • Raised bezels
  • Durable watch band included

Cons

  • Limited color options

Price: $19.99

3. Protective ultra slim case – Spigen ThinFit

If you own the latest Apple Watch 10, it’s a good idea to protect your device with this slim yet secure case by Spigen. It’s made from a premium polycarbonate material for a sleek look. It’s super easy to install and quickly snaps on your Apple Watch.

The precise cutouts ensure easy access to the Digital Crown, speaker, vents, and side button. It’s available in black and clear variants.

Compatibility: Apple Watch Series 10

Pros

  • Great everyday protection
  • Super durable, scratch-proof material
  • Seamless functionality of watch buttons and speaker

Cons

  • Designed only for the Apple Watch Series 10
  • Does not come with a band

Price: $16.14

4. A classic leather band – NOMAD Traditional Band

A leather band is a timeless Apple Watch accessory that looks good and lasts a long time. My favorite is this one from NOMAD that’s made from minimally treated, vegetable-tanned leather. It develops a classic patina with time that looks unique and luxurious.

The stainless steel lugs and buckle further add to the appeal. You can opt for the black or rustic brown colors that are both perfect for everyday wear. It’s certainly one of the best Apple Watch bands you can add to your collection.

Compatibility: Apple Watch Ultra & Ultra 2, Series 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, SE, and all previous versions of Apple Watch

Pros

  • Genuine leather
  • Made in the USA
  • Lasts a long time

Cons

  • Only two color options

Price: $80

5. Designer band for women – Kate Spade New York Store

For a sophisticated, feminine look, an Apple Watch band from Kate Spade New York is a worthy investment. You can elevate your watch’s sporty style with braided or scalloped silicone, keep things classic with a plated stainless-steel bracelet or genuine leather band, or brighten things up with a fun pattern.

These bands are designed for the Apple Watch Series 1-9, so they may not be suitable for the latest Apple Watch 10. Nonetheless, they look modern and chic while being comfortable to wear.

Compatibility: Apple Watch Series 1-9, Ultra 1 and 2, SE 1 and 2

Pros

  • Unique, elegant design
  • Comfortable fit
  • Different materials and color options
  • Wide compatibility with almost all Apple Watch models

Cons

  • A bit pricey

Price: $98.00

6. Best portable charger: Native Union Voyage

It’s essential to have more than one Apple Watch charger so that you never find yourself out without one on hand.

This sleek little wireless charger from Native Union is the ultimate travel-friendly power solution, boasting an ultra-thin, lightweight, and foldable design. It effortlessly slips into your pocket and can recharge an Apple Watch Series 9 up to 80% in just around 45 minutes.

Moreover, it can transform into a stand that can also charge other devices like your iPhone and AirPods. Choose from classic black or sandstone color options.

Compatibility: All Qi-compatible smartphones, earbuds, and watches

Pros

  • Super portable
  • Speedy charging
  • Universal compatibility
  • Multifunctional usage as a charger and stand

Cons

  • Quite pricey

Price: $99.99

7. Best charging stand – Belkin

If you’re looking for an all-in-one charging solution for your Apple Watch, iPhone, and AirPods, here’s a great option from Belkin. This foldable stand offers versatility, allowing you to adjust the viewing angle and charge your devices effortlessly at home, at work, or on the go.

It provides blazing-fast wireless charging with the latest Qi2 technology, delivering up to 15W of power to compatible Apple Watches, iPhones, and other devices. Moreover, it also supports Apple’s StandBy feature.

I appreciate how it comes complete with a 36W power supply and a 5-foot USB-C cable so that you are ready to use it immediately.

Compatibility: All Apple Watches, iPhones, AirPods, and other devices.

Pros

  • Portable charging solution
  • Supports multiple devices
  • Adjustable viewing angles

Cons

  • A bit expensive

Price: $99.99

8. Mini power bank – Anker MagGo

If you’re always on the go, this power bank that’s specially designed for the Apple Watch can add a lot of convenience to your life. It boasts a capacity of 10,000mAh, ensuring seamless charging and optimal efficiency for your Apple Watch and other devices.

With a 30W USB-C port and a built-in 5W Apple Watch wireless charger, you can charge multiple devices simultaneously at high speeds.

The best part is the super compact design. It can fit effortlessly into pockets or bags, making it an ideal travel companion. Moreover, the power bank itself fully recharges in just 1.5 hours with a 30W maximum input, ensuring you’re always prepared.

Compatibility: All Apple Watches and other devices

Pros

  • Super compact and travel-friendly
  • Certified for Apple Watch
  • Fast charging and recharging speeds
  • 24-month warranty

Cons

  • A bit pricey

Price: $79.99

9. Best carrying case: MoKo Storage Box

If you need to store or travel with your Apple Watch, check out this handy carrying case from MoKo. It protects your watch and other small devices, such as AirPods, during travel or when they’re not in use.

It’s made of premium PU material that’s shock-absorbing, and it features a removable silicone holder that securely fits your Apple Watch and AirPods, allowing for organized storage.

It also comes equipped with a carabiner, so it can be easily attached to bags or belts, enhancing its portability. This feature is particularly useful for travelers and individuals with active lifestyles.

Compatibility: All Apple Watches, All AirPods and AirPods Pro

Pros

  • Protective and durable
  • Compact and lightweight design
  • Removable silicone holder for organized storage
  • Includes a carabiner for easy attachment

Cons

  • Does not provide charging capabilities on the go

Price: $14.99

10. Apple Watch bands wall mount- Twelve South TimePorter

If you’re a collector of Apple Watch bands, you probably need a reliable storage holder to keep things organized. The Twelve South TimePorter Wall Mount is an elegant solution for organizing and displaying your bands. It keeps them easily accessible and showcased beautifully.

It securely holds up to six Apple Watch bands, accommodating all sizes and styles. The design mimics the Apple Watch connector, allowing for quick and easy attachment and removal of bands.

Moreover, installation is straightforward with the included 3M Command Strips, enabling attachment to various surfaces without causing damage. Pretty cool!

Compatibility: All Apple Watch bands

Pros

  • Sleek and minimalist design
  • Easy installation with damage-free removal
  • Expandable to accommodate growing band collections

Cons

  • Limited to holding six bands per unit
  • The adhesive strips might not work well on all surfaces

Price: $29.99

Signing off

With the right accessories, your Apple Watch can fit even better into your lifestyle. Which of our recommendations are you adding to your collection? If there’s anything else you’re looking for, let us know in the comments below.

@graph.description: It provides all-around protection with a raised bezel that shields your Apple Watch screen from accidental bumps and scratches. Moreover, it’s lightweight, with clicky buttons and precise cutouts for seamless operation of your watch’s screen and crown.

@graph.name: Spigen Rugged Armor Pro Apple Watch Case
@graph.description: The Rugged Armor Pro case features a dual-layer construction combining flexible TPU and durable polycarbonate materials. This design provides a robust defense against shocks, drops, and scratches.

@graph.name: Spigen ThinFit Apple Watch Case
@graph.description: It’s made from a premium polycarbonate material for a sleek look. It’s super easy to install and quickly snaps on your Apple Watch. The precise cutouts ensure easy access to the Digital Crown, speaker, vents, and side button.

@graph.name: NOMAD Traditional Band
@graph.description: My favorite is this one from NOMAD that’s made from minimally treated, vegetable-tanned leather. It develops a classic patina with time that looks unique and luxurious. The stainless steel lugs and buckle further add to the appeal.

@graph.name: Kate Spade New York Designer Band
@graph.description: You can elevate your watch’s sporty style with braided or scalloped silicone, keep things classic with a plated stainless-steel bracelet or genuine leather band, or brighten things up with a fun pattern.

@graph.name: Anker MagGo Power Bank for Apple Watch
@graph.description: It boasts a capacity of 10,000mAh, ensuring seamless charging and optimal efficiency for your Apple Watch and other devices. With a 30W USB-C port and a built-in 5W Apple Watch wireless charger, you can charge multiple devices simultaneously at high speeds.

@graph.name: MoKo Storage Box Compatible with Apple Watch
@graph.description: It protects your watch and other small devices, such as AirPods, during travel or when they’re not in use. It also comes equipped with a carabiner, so it can be easily attached to bags or belts, enhancing its portability.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: How to change or customize alarm sound on iPhone

content.rendered:
The default alarm sound on iPhones works well, but waking up to it every day can get boring. Thankfully, Apple allows you to change your iPhone’s alarm sound. You can choose from the alarm sounds Apple offers or set your favorite song as your alarm sound. Keep reading to learn how to change the alarm sound on your iPhone.

How to change your alarm sound on an iPhone

If you don’t like the default alarm sound, you can choose from the multiple options available in the Clock app. Here’s what you need to do:

  1. Open the Clock app on your iPhone and go to the Alarms tab.
  2. Here, tap the + icon in the top-right corner to create a new alarm. Alternatively, select one of the existing alarms to change its sound.
  3. Now, tap on Sound.

  4. Next, choose a tone listed under Ringtones.
  5. Alternatively, scroll down to the bottom, tap on Classical, and select one from the classical alarm sound options.
  6. Now, tap Back in the upper-left corner to go to the main alarm screen and tap Save in the top-right to save the alarm settings.

How to set a custom alarm sound on an iPhone

Not everyone prefers to wake up to the same age-old ringtones. If you feel the same and some prefer devotional or rock music to start your morning, Apple has got you covered, too. Follow the steps below to set a custom alarm sound on your iPhone:

Set a song as your alarm sound

If you want to wake up to your favorite song instead of a default tone, do this:

  1. Open the Clock app and go to the Alarms tab.
  2. Add a new alarm or choose an existing one.
  3. Tap on Sound.
  4. Here, choose one of the downloaded songs under the Songs section or tap Pick a Song to select one from your Apple Music library.

  5. Go back to the previous page and tap Save in the top-right corner to save changes.

Buy a tone for your alarm

Alternatively, if you want a unique alarm tone, you can purchase ringtones from the iTunes Store. Here’s how:

  1. From the Alarms tab in the Clock app, add a new alarm or select an existing one.
  2. Tap on Sound.
  3. Now, tap on Tone Store under the Store section.
  4. You will be redirected to the App Store to install the iTunes Store app if it does not already exist on your iPhone.

  5. In iTunes Store, browse or search for a song and purchase it.
  6. Once downloaded, go back to the alarm settings and select the purchased song under the Songs section. 
  7. Go back to the main alarm page and hit Save.

How to change alarm sound vibration pattern on iPhone

The Taptic Engine on iPhones is strong enough to wake you up even if you have not set an alarm sound. However, if you feel it isn’t strong enough or too strong for your liking, you can choose another one from the available options or create a new vibration pattern altogether. Here’s how:

  1. In the Clock app, go to Alarms, and either add a new Alarm or select an existing one.
  2. Tap on Sound and choose Haptics on the following screen.
  3. Next, choose one of the available options under the Standard section.
  4. You can even choose the None option if you want to disable vibration for the alarm clock on your iPhone.

  5. Alternatively, tap on Create New Vibration.
  6. Tap with your fingers on the screen to record a new vibration pattern.

  7. Once done, tap Stop, then Save in the top-right corner.
  8. Give your vibration a name and tap the Save button.

  9. Finally, go back and tap Save to save the alarm.

Wake up to your own tunes…

Changing your alarm sound to something melodious can make waking up a more pleasant experience. The cherry on top is that iOS natively offers plenty of options to personalize your wake-up routine so you don’t have to rely on a third-party app.

Still have some doubts or questions? Do not hesitate to share them with us in the comments.

FAQs

Why is my alarm sound not changing?

Forgetting to hit the Save button in the alarm settings or choosing the None option accidentally are some common reasons why the alarm sound isn’t changing on your iPhone.

How do I change the alarm volume?

Go to Settings → Sounds & Haptics and use the Ringtones and Alerts slider to change the alarm volume on your iPhone.

Can I use third-party apps for alarm sounds?

Unfortunately, Apple’s Clock app doesn’t allow direct integration with third-party apps. However, if you want a truly custom alarm sound, you can create and add ringtones using GarageBand or iTunes.

  • How to set and manage alarms on your Apple Watch
  • How to set an alarm on Mac
  • iOS 18.2: How to limit your iPhone’s speaker volume
  • How to Turn Off Vibration on iPhone

title.rendered: Natura Umana: The future of AI is here – And it’s designed for you

content.rendered:
The way we interact with technology is changing—fast. Screens were meant to connect us, but they’ve become constant distractions, pulling us away from real life. The biggest tech companies aren’t just offering services—they’re competing for every second of our attention.

The result? A society that is more connected than ever—but more distracted than ever, too.

The average person now spends 7.32 hours daily on screens—nearly a third of our waking lives. Instead of deep reflection, creativity, or meaningful conversations, we’re caught in a loop of endless information consumption, chasing updates and losing focus on what truly matters. It’s wild when you really think about it. The consequences? Declining attention spans, increased stress, weakened real-world connections, and an entire generation raised on distractions.

The world has adapted to technology—but what if technology could adapt to us instead?

That’s exactly what Natura Umana is building: a human-first AI experience that lets you speak, interact, and collaborate with AI in a way that feels completely natural—without needing to use a screen. They say their goal is to let technology enhances life rather than consume it.

Introducing Natura Umana: A new vision for AI

Natura Umana is a shift in how we engage with digital intelligence. Instead of demanding attention, it’s designed to fit seamlessly into life, allowing technology to support rather than distract.

At the heart of this experience is NatureOS®, a voice-first AI operating system that integrates across your devices, starting with iPhone (MacBook support is coming soon). AI People, intelligent digital beings, learn and adapt, helping with daily tasks, and HumanPods®, open-ear AIpowered earbuds, provide instant access to AI without needing to look at a screen.

NatureOS: The AI that understands you

Unlike traditional AI assistants, NatureOS isn’t just reactive—it’s proactive. It learns, adapts, and integrates into your daily habits, offering help before you even ask.

AI People: Digital Beings That Grow With You. AI People aren’t just virtual assistants; they evolve through real interactions. With their Humanity Layer, they develop long-term memory, core beliefs, adaptive behavior, and intuition, adjusting responses based on mood, tone, and context.

  • Natural conversations—no stiff, robotic interactions.
  • Learning and adaptation—the more you use them, the better they understand you.
  • Collaboration—AI People forward between eachother to offer better support.
  • Task automation—handling scheduling, research, and reminders without manual input.
  • Multimedia communication—text, call, or send images just like with human contacts.
  • Seamless integrations—for example: Apple Health, Fitbit, Oura, or Whoop for fitness tracking, so your AI Fitness Coach actually knows what’s up with your stats.

AI People can also browse the web, manage emails, and make bookings independently— currently achieving 89% accuracy on real-world tasks (WebVoyager benchmark).

The AI People at Launch

  • Nature – 1st point of contact for general inquiries Therapist – Mental well-being support
  • Fitness Coach – Personalized training & scheduling
  • Consciousness – Self-awareness & habit-building
  • Not Financial Advisor – Financial insights & strategies

Coming Soon: Personal News, Language Coach, Legal Advisor, Travel Guide, and more.
PS. If you still wanna chat with Claude, GPT-4, Gemini, or LLaMA, you can.

HumanPods: The AI wearable you’ll forget you’re wearing

To make this experience seamless, Natura Umana developed HumanPods®, open-ear AI-powered earbuds built for all-day interaction.

  • Patented Gravity Hook Technology ensures a weightless, secure fit for all-day comfort.
  • Open-ear design keeps you aware of your surroundings.
  • Instant AI activation—just double-tap to talk to your AI People.
  • Gesture controls—adjust volume, answer calls, and activate AI with simple movements.
  • 9-hour battery life (plus 24 hours in the charging case).

No need to unlock a device or launch an app—just speak, and your AI is there.

2025 Roadmap highlights

  • 🚀 Q1 Launch – NatureOS for iPhone, HumanPods, AI People, and key integrations.
  • 🌍 Expanding AI Ecosystem – Mac support, deeper third-party integrations.
  • 🤖 Next-Gen AI Agency – AI People will gain the ability to handle more complex, independent actions.

And in the long run? A world where screens aren’t necessary——because AI is finally designed to work the way humans do.

A glimpse into the future without screens – are you ready for it?

Look, I know change is scary. But the way I see it, this is the next big shift in tech. Maybe it’s time to try something new other than screens everywhere. I think we need our time, attention and freedom back.

So, what do you think? Would you ditch your screen for something that actually works the way you do, not the other way around? Drop your thoughts in the comments.

excerpt.rendered: A new way to interact with technology.

title.rendered: How to quickly fix an iPhone alarm not going off

content.rendered:
Have you ever slept through an important event because your iPhone alarm decided to take a nap? You’re not alone. Many users on the Apple forum have reported issues with the iPhone alarm sound not going off sometimes after updating to iOS 18.

So, in this post, I will share potential reasons why the alarm on your iPhone is not going off and provide practical solutions to get it working again. Keep reading!

Why is my iPhone alarm not going off?

If you’re wondering why your iPhone alarm isn’t making any noise, there could be several reasons. The common culprits are the low volume level and damaged speakers. Before we discuss the fixes, let’s quickly address this issue.

To ensure your alarm is audible, increase the volume level on your iPhone. Press the Volume Up button or go to Settings → Sounds & Haptics → Adjust the slider. Also, toggle off Change with Buttons to ensure the volume level doesn’t get lower by buttons.

Next, make sure your iPhone’s speakers are functioning well. To do so, play some media through Apple Music, YouTube, etc.

Besides, the silent mode sometimes mutes the alarm tone. If you use iPhone 15 Pro or Pro Max, turn off Silent mode in Sound & Haptics settings. Else, toggle off the Ring switch on the side.

Now, check if your alarm is working as expected. If not, other factors, such as misconfigured alarm settings, third-party alarm apps, or system glitches in iOS 18, could be at play.

9 troubleshooting steps to fix iPhone alarm not going off

In most cases, adjusting the volume level resolves the alarm issues. However, if your iPhone’s alarm sound is still not going off or the snooze feature is not working, follow the solutions below.

1. Check alarm settings

First, ensure you have set an alarm sound. Without this, no audio will play when the alarm goes off; your iPhone will only vibrate.

If you’ve mistakenly set the alarm sound to “None,” here’s how to fix it.

  1. Open the Clock app on your iPhone. 
  2. Select the Alarm option from the Menu at the bottom. 
  3. Select the Alarm you want to make the changes for. 
  4. Tap Sound. 
  5. Scroll on top and select a ringtone. You can also set a song from Apple Music as your iPhone alarm.

  6. Now, tap Vibration and select a vibration pattern. 
  7. Tap Sound → Back at the top left of the screen. 
  8. On the next screen, tap Save. 

Please do not skip the last step, as that is the only way to ensure all the changes are applied.

Next, double-check the alarm time and days. You may have mistakenly set the time to 7 PM instead of 7 AM and forgot to set recurring alarms. Tap Repeat to select days you need the alarm. Tap Save.

Finally, if your iPhone alarm does not go off after snooze, toggle off Snooze →. Wait for a few minutes, then enable it again. Tap Save.

2. Check Sleep Schedule

If you use the Bedtime feature on your iPhone and have set the same time for Wake time and the alarm, there are chances that both these features might clash and neigher of them would function.

To prevent this, you should change the time of either of these features or delete the sleep schedule altogether.

To disable the Sleep or Bedtime alarm, go to the Health app → Select Sleep in the Browse menu → Full Schedule & Options → Toggle off Sleep Schedule.

If you want to keep the feature, simply disable the alarm in the sleep schedule. Tap Edit under Your Schedule → Toggle off Alarm → Hit Done.

3. Restart your iPhone

Restarting the device is the easiest solution to fixing common iPhone issues. It helps clear cache memory and resolves some software bugs or glitches.

To restart your iPhone, go to Settings → General → Shut Down → Slide to power off.

Once your iPhone is restarted, check if it shows the correct date and time. If not, your alarms will not go off at the expected time. To ensure this, go to Settings → General → Date & Time Toggle on Set Automatically → Select your Time Zone.

4. Disable StandBy mode

StandBy mode is a great feature introduced in iOS 17. However, it has been found guilty of causing an unforeseen bug with the alarm system. According to Apple forums, the iPhone alarm snooze feature does not work when StandBy mode is activated.

You may try disabling it and checking if the alarm is going off as expected. To do so, navigate to Settings → StandBy → Toggle off StandBy.

Quick tip: Don’t switch off your iPhone before going to bed, as your alarm will not work. Also, ensure it has enough battery to sustain the whole night. You may turn off Wi-Fi, cellular data, and Bluetooth to avoid overnight battery drain.

5. Disconnect Bluetooth or wired headphones

Usually, alarm audio plays through the device’s built-in speakers even when connected to wired or Bluetooth audio devices. However, some bugs and glitches hamper the process.

For example, your iPhone might be stuck in headphone mode. In such cases, the best option is to disconnect your iPhone from any wired or Bluetooth audio device. Simply open Control Center → Tap the blue Bluetooth icon.

6. Uninstall third-party alarm apps

There are a ton of third-party alarm apps for iPhones available on the App Store. No doubt, they might have additional features over the default Clock app. However, you’re better off uninstalling these apps. Yes, there is a slim chance that doing so might fix your issue.

Some apps ask for weird permissions and might interfere with the functioning of the Clock app and its alarm feature, ultimately rendering both apps useless. So, go right ahead and get rid of these apps, as the native apps work fine as an alarm clock.

7. Delete and recreate alarm

Have you set too many alarms? Is the long list of alarms confusing you? All these alarms may be causing incompatibility issues; hence, none are working as intended.

In that case, you should delete all the alarms and start anew. Get rid of everything and set a new alarm for whatever time you want. Here’s how to do it,

  1. Open the Clock app on your iPhone. 
  2. Select the Alarm option from the Menu at the bottom. 
  3. Tap Edit at the top left corner.
  4. Select the minus button in red and tap Delete.

     
  5. Repeat the steps same steps for all the alarms. 
  6. Tap Done at the top left corner once you’ve deleted all the alarms.

     
  7. Now, go ahead and set the alarm for your desired time. 

8. Update your iPhone

There is no operating system that has no software bugs and glitches. Moreover, iOS has lately been a breeding ground for software bugs due to all the new features.

I cannot be one hundred percent sure and claim that none of these bugs affect the Clock app on iPhone. Instead, it is more than likely affected by one of these bugs and malfunctioning.

The best solution to this problem is to update iOS to the latest version. Go to Settings → General → Software Update → Tap Download and Install if any update is available.

9. Reset all settings

If none of the above solutions help fix the issue of the iPhone alarm not working, the next best option is to factory reset your iPhone. Yes, you will lose all the data. To prevent that from happening, please back up all your iPhone’s data to iCloud so that you can restore your iPhone from the iCloud backup. Follow the steps mentioned below to reset your iPhone.

  1. Open Settings on your iPhone. 
  2. Navigate to General.
  3. Tap Transfer or Reset iPhone.
  4. Select Reset → Reset All Settings.
  5. Enter your Passcode to confirm your selection and follow the on-screen instructions.

Signing off…

I hope you were able to get your iPhone alarms working properly again and avoid missing appointments or oversleeping. Sadly, if nothing fixes the issue, it’s time to contact Apple Support. If it is a hardware issue, get a Genius Bar appointment to resolve this.

If you have any other questions, let me know in the comments below. I’ll get back to you as soon as possible!

  • How to set an alarm on Apple Watch

title.rendered: Powerbeats Pro 2 vs. AirPods Pro 2: A quick comparison

content.rendered:
Key takeaways
  • The Powerbeats Pro 2 feature an over-ear hook design, providing a secure fit ideal for workouts. In contrast, the AirPods Pro 2 offer a compact in-ear design suitable for everyday use.
  • Both earbuds are powered by Apple H2 chip, delivering advanced features and high-quality audio.
  • The Powerbeats Pro 2 promise up to 45 hours of playback and are priced at $249.99. The AirPods Pro 2 offer up to 30 hours total listening time, at a similar price point.

Apple’s subsidiary, Beats, has officially launched the Powerbeats Pro 2 earbuds, a successor to the Powerbeats Pro. The company’s latest offering packs features like heart rate monitoring, Active Noise Cancellation, and Transparency Mode, among others, pitting itself as a strong contender against Apple’s AirPods Pro 2, known for its sleek design and advanced audio capabilities.

If you are looking to get yourself a new pair of earbuds between the two but are not sure which one to pick, this Powerbeats Pro 2 vs. AirPods Pro 2 comparison details everything you need to know about the two earbuds to make an informed decision.

Powerbeats Pro 2 vs. AirPods Pro 2: Key differences

Before we jump into the details, let’s see the specs at a glance:

Build and design

The Powerbeats Pro 2 is designed with athletes and sports enthusiasts in mind. As such, they feature over-ear hooks made from a nickel-titanium alloy with in-ear tips to ensure a secure fit.

On paper, the Powerbeats Pro 2’s specs suggest they are 20% smaller and lighter than the predecessor. Beats claims that the ear hooks have been tested on nearly 1,000 athletes to ensure they offer a good fit and are comfortable to wear. Besides, the Powerbeats Pro 2 includes five different-sized ear tips for a customizable fit. 

In contrast, the AirPods Pro 2 features a compact in-ear design with acoustic seal silicone tips, offering a snug fit. Their lightweight and minimalist aesthetic makes them comfortable for extended use. That said, the AirPods Pro may struggle to remain in your ears during workouts, making a strong case in favor of the Powerbeats Pro 2.

Sound quality

Similar to the design, Beats has reengineered acoustic architecture on the Powerbeats Pro 2, promising clearer highs, deeper bass, and richer mid-range tones. The earbuds also get a custom-built dual-layer transducer to minimize distortion.

The unique design precisely aligns drivers to each earbud’s nozzle so you can get the best sound delivery. Moreover, Beats says it has incorporated new venting to enhance bass while reducing pressure. This bass-forward, energetic sound profile is perfect for workouts. In addition, the Powerbeats Pro 2 also supports Adaptive EQ and Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking. As a result, you can truly enjoy your music in any training environment! 

When it comes to Apple’s AirPods Pro 2, you get a balanced sound profile suitable for various music genres. The earbuds have Personalized Volume and Adaptive Audio that uses machine learning to understand your listening preferences and automatically adapts sound based on that. Moreover, there are other similar audio features, such as Adaptive EQ and Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking onboard. 

Features and Functionality 

The Powerbeats Pro 2 introduces heart rate monitoring for the first time. Beats claims that it uses LED optical sensors to assess your blood flow. The best part is that all this health data is integrated into your favorite fitness apps in real time. You can use on-ear buttons and tactile volume rockers to control your sound. 

Additionally, the earbuds are equipped with an Apple H2 chip to provide advanced Active Noise Cancelling, Transparency mode, and Voice Isolation. It also ensures you get iOS-specific features like Find My, Audio Sharing, and hands-free Siri. Moreover, the Class 1 Bluetooth promises an extended range and fewer dropouts.

The AirPods Pro 2 also supports all these features along with Conversation Awareness and end-to-end wireless audio latency for games, as they have an Apple H2 chip as well. Moreover, Apple has incorporated new hearing health features. So, users with mild to moderate hearing loss can use your AirPods as a hearing aid.

Battery life and charging

Beats claims that the Powerbeats Pro 2 earbuds offer up to 10 hours of playback on a single charge, with the case providing an additional 35 hours. Moreover, to match your quick routine, they pack the Fast Fuel technology. So, you can get up to 90 minutes of playback with just a five-minute charge.

You can easily carry your Powerbeats Pro 2 everywhere, as the charging case is 33% smaller than its predecessor. Also, these are the first pair of Powerbeats earbuds to support Qi-compatible wireless charging. 

On the other hand, the AirPods Pro 2 provides up to 6 hours of listening time on a single charge, with the case offering up to 30 hours of total listening time. They support MagSafe wireless charging and quick charge features, providing convenience for users on the go. For Lossless Audio on your Apple Vision Pro, you can listen for up to four hours.

Connectivity and compatibility

Both the Powerbeats Pro 2 and AirPods Pro 2 are powered by Apple’s H2 chip, ensuring seamless connectivity with Apple devices. The Powerbeats Pro 2 also offers compatibility with Android devices through the Beats app. You can set up one-touch pairing, customizable controls, battery status widgets, heart rate monitoring, and Locate My Beats from the app.

The AirPods Pro 2 are primarily designed for use within the Apple ecosystem, offering features like automatic switching between devices and audio sharing. While they can connect to non-Apple devices via Bluetooth, some features may be limited. 

Powerbeats Pro 2 vs. AirPods Pro 2: Pricing

Both the Powerbeats Pro 2 and AirPods Pro 2 are priced at $249 in the U.S. In India, you can purchase the AirPods Pro 2 for Rs. 24,900 and the Powerbeats Pro 2 for Rs. 29,900.

Verdict: Which wireless earbuds should you choose? 

Both Powerbeats Pro 2 and AirPods Pro 2 are excellent products with cutting-edge advanced features. So, choosing between them depends on your lifestyle and priorities. Here’s a quick summary to help you out. 

  • Powerbeats Pro 2: Ideal for fitness enthusiasts and athletes, these earbuds offer a secure fit with over-ear hooks, heart rate monitoring, robust bass for workout motivation, and extended battery life. They are designed to withstand rigorous activities, making them a top choice for active users.
  • AirPods Pro 2: Suitable for daily use, these earbuds feature a compact design, 2x quieter pro-level Active Noise Cancellation, Conversation Awareness, Personalized Volume, and seamless integration with Apple devices. They cater to users seeking a versatile and immersive audio experience in various environments.

Ultimately, if your primary focus is on fitness and you require features like heart rate monitoring, a secure fit during workouts, and better sweat and water resistance, along with good battery life, the Powerbeats Pro 2 is better suited for your needs. Conversely, if you value advanced audio features and seamless connectivity for everyday use, the AirPods Pro 2 would be the better choice.

mainEntity.name: Can I turn off read receipts for group chats?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not turn off read receipts specifically for a group chat if you have them enabled in the Messages app settings. Unlike one-on-one conversations, there’s no option to disable read receipts for specific group chats while keeping them on for others.

title.rendered: How to use AutoFill to enter your information automatically on iPhone

content.rendered:
Key takeaway
  • AutoFill on iPhone and iPad quickly fills in personal details and passwords, making online tasks faster and easier.
  • You can enable AutoFill for contact info, passwords, passkeys, and credit cards, and it works seamlessly in Safari, apps, and even PDF forms.
  • AutoFill protects your data with Face ID, Touch ID, or a passcode so your details are never misused.

Your iPhone saves your passwords, passkeys, and verification codes securely in the Passwords app. However, it doesn’t make sense to manually see, copy, and paste your credentials every time. This is where AutoFill comes in. It quickly fills in the required details including your payment information. This article will guide you on how to use AutoFill on your iPhone and iPad.

What is AutoFill and how does it work?

AutoFill is a feature on your iPhone and iPad that helps you input your credentials and payment details into forms and login fields without typing them each time. So, you can log into accounts and do online shopping faster and easier. It also reduces the likelihood of errors when entering information manually.

When you encounter a form or login page, AutoFill recognizes the required fields and offers to fill them with your saved information. This process is secure, as the data is encrypted and pasted only after you authenticate your Face ID or Touch ID. Additionally, you can manage or delete your information at any time through your device’s settings.

Types of information AutoFill can handle:

  • Contact information: AutoFill can input your name, address, phone number, and email address into forms.
  • Usernames, passwords, and 2FA codes: It can access the Passwords app to populate your login details for various websites and apps. Thus, you can sign in quickly.
  • Credit card information: AutoFill can store your credit card numbers and expiration dates, so you don’t have to enter them each time you make a purchase.

Now that you have a clear understanding of the AutoFill feature on your iPhone and iPad, let’s see how to enable it.

How to set up AutoFill on iPhone and iPad

To make the most of AutoFill, you’ll need to configure it to use your personal information, payment methods, and passwords.

Configure your contact information

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone.
  2. Scroll down, tap Apps, and select Safari.

  3. Tap on AutoFill.
  4. Here, toggle on Use Contact Info.
  5. Tap My Info and choose your contact card from the list.

Add payment method

If you do online shopping frequently, you should save your credit card details in AutoFill. So, you don’t need to look for the details or run into typing errors while paying. However, note that you need to use Safari to complete the purchase.

  1. Go to the Safari settings as mentioned above.
  2. Tap on AutoFill and toggle on Credit Cards.

  3. Next, select Saved Credit Cards and authenticate using Face ID, Touch ID, or your passcode.
  4. Tap Add Credit Card.
  5. Now, you may click a photo of your credit card to fill in the information or enter your card details manually.
  6. Once completed, hit Done to save it.

You may repeat the process to add more credit cards.

Enable AutoFill passwords, passkeys, and 2FA codes

The best and most common use of the AutoFill feature is to input your credentials and verification codes automatically when signing into apps and websites.

  1. Open the Settings app and go to General.
  2. Scroll down and select AutoFill & Passwords.
  3. Now, toggle on AutoFill Passwords and Passkeys.
  4. Also, ensure the Passwords app is enabled.

Note

AutoFill can also work with third-party password managers like 1Password or LastPass. To use a third-party password manager, ensure it is installed and set up on your device, then toggle it on in the AutoFill settings. If you want to move to Apple Passwords app, you can import your old passwords into it.

How to use AutoFill in Safari and apps on your iPhone

Once configured, AutoFill can enter information in Safari and supported apps. When you encounter a login page, tap on the username field. You will see an AutoFill suggestions prompt. Tap Fill in Username/Password and authenticate your Face ID to input your credentials.

If you missed the prompt or have multiple accounts on that website or app, you can manually choose which username to autofill. When you tap the text field on the login page, you will see a key icon at the top of your keyboard. Now, choose the appropriate credential to log in. You may also select the password manager where you save your password.

Safari also allows you to fill out website forms quickly, making it helpful when registering an account or signing up for a service.

On the Sign-up page, I needed to input my details. Simply, tapping on the respective text field, my keyboard suggested my first and last name, my saved address as home, and my email address. I just selected the suggestion, and AutoFill populated all the details in the right field.

Next, in the Card number field, AutoFill showed my saved credit card with its name and ending number. So, I can quickly select which payment method I want to use. Similarly, you can use AutoFill to complete any transaction on your iPhone apps and Safari.

AutoFill your data in PDF forms

With iOS 17.2 and later, you can use AutoFill to complete PDF forms. However, note that the PDF should have a fillable format so that your iPhone can recognize the text fields and populate your details.

Once you have downloaded the PDF, save it in your Files app and open it there. You will see an AutoFill Form prompt at the top. Tap it to start editing and select the field you want to fill in. AutoFill will suggest relevant data based on your saved information. You may select it or choose other options.

There’s more to it! To learn in-depth, go through our guide on how to AutoFill PDF forms on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Troubleshoot AutoFill issues on your iPhone or iPad

Though AutoFill is easy to use, you may run into issues when you want to input details. If you encounter problems with AutoFill:

  • Ensure AutoFill is enabled and properly set up as mentioned above.
  • Verify if your contact details and saved credit card information are current.
  • If a password does not appear, ensure iCloud Keychain is enabled. It helps to sync your passwords across your Apple devices and keeps them up-to-date.
  • A simple restart can often resolve temporary glitches affecting AutoFill.
  • Ensure your device is running the latest version of iOS or iPadOS by going to Settings → General → Software Update.

If issues persist, you may take our expert solutions from the AutoFill not working guide.

Signing off

This is how you can enable and use AutoFill on iPhone and iPad. I hope this brief article helped you streamline tasks like filling out forms, entering passwords, and completing purchases, making them faster and more efficient. Remember to keep your AutoFill information updated to ensure your personal data remains accurate.

If you need further assistance, share your queries via the comments section below.

title.rendered: 4 reasons why your iPhone charger gets hot and how to fix it

content.rendered:
When you charge your iPhone, you will notice the charger gets warm. While this is normal, there might be a problem if it starts overheating. Chargers work on the basic principle of electricity, wherein the resistance during the flow of current through components generates heat. You may have an issue if this heat is abnormally high, like when you can’t touch it with your bare hands or get a burning smell. In this article, I will explain why this happens and what you can do to prevent or fix it.

Table of Contents
  1. Using an uncertified, third-party charger or cable
  2. Using faulty bricks and charging cables
  3. Charging in a hot environment
  4. Charging your iPhone while using

1. Using an uncertified, third-party charger or cable

Although using an original Apple charger to charge your iPhone is always recommended, if you are using third-party chargers or cable, make sure they are MFi-certified.

For those unaware, Apple provides certification for accessories called Made For iPhone (MFi), which communicates that the accessory adheres to Apple’s performance and quality standards. The certified accessories can be verified on the MFi website by entering the model number or brand name.

If your charger is not original or MFi-certified, it is likely a low-quality accessory, which might be why it’s heating up.

Possible fix:

Replace your low-quality charger and cable immediately with an original or certified one. You can get MFi-certified accessories for your iPhone directly on Amazon.

2. Using faulty bricks and charging cables 

Like all electronic devices, chargers and cables are susceptible to damage. Whether due to manufacturing defects or rough usage, even a tiny mishap inside may cause the charger to heat up while charging. To check this, try to use the charger and cables to charge a different device. If the issue persists, it is most probably the fault of the charger or cable.

Possible fix:

Replace the faulty charging brick and cable immediately. If you continue using them, your iPhone may suffer long-term damage. Use the original Apple or MFi-certified chargers and cables, as suggested in the above fixes.

3. Charging in a hot environment

If you live in a relatively hot environment, your charger and iPhone will most probably overheat while charging due to the high temperature. The combination of high environmental temperature and the heat produced by the charger may be catastrophic to your device.

Possible fix:

If you have one around, turn on the air conditioner or a cooler, and that should help reduce the temperature. If none of these facilities are available, you should stop charging immediately until the heat cools down.

4. Charging your iPhone while using

Another reason your charger might be heating is if you use your iPhone while charging. Your iPhone can heat up while using, and the same heat may be conducted onto the cable and the charger, causing it to overheat.

Possible fix:

It is always recommended not to use your iPhone while it is charging. Let your iPhone charge, then unplug the charger before you start using it.

Signing off…

Well, now you know why your iPhone charger is heating while charging. If none of the reasons match your criteria for heating, then the issue might be within your iPhone. Some defects in the charging hardware or battery inside may also cause heating, so it is wise to get it checked at a nearby Apple authorized service center to deduce the issue and correct it immediately.

While you protect your iPhone and charger from heat, it is also important to check on your iPhone’s battery health to keep it running for a long period. If you are unaware of battery health, check out our article on how to maintain your iPhone battery health to learn more.

Check out these as well:

  • What does “Slow Charger” mean on iPhone, and how to fix it
  • How to fast charge your iPhone and iPad
  • Best GaN chargers

title.rendered: How to use Starlink satellite connectivity on iPhone

content.rendered:
With iOS 18.3, Apple has enhanced its satellite connectivity by introducing the ability to send and receive SMS messages to anyone via satellite. Following this, T-Mobile, one of the United States’ biggest mobile carriers, has made the public beta of its Starlink satellite feature available to all users in the U.S.

As a result, any user, even if they are subscribed to AT&T or Verizon, can sign up to test the Starlink connectivity on their supported iPhone or Android phone. Keep reading to learn more about using Starlink satellite connectivity on your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • Pre-requisites for using Starlink satellite on iPhone
  • How does T-Mobile's Starlink satellite feature work?
  • What Starlink support means for iPhone users, and how it's different from Globalstar
  • T-Mobile's Starlink satellite service: Pricing
  • How to use Starlink satellite connectivity on iPhone
  • How to disable Starlink support on iPhone

Pre-requisites for using Starlink satellite on iPhone

You need to sign up for T-Mobile’s Starlink public beta to test its satellite connectivity. But before you do that, ensure that the following requirements are met:

  • A compatible iPhone: iPhone 14, iPhone 15, or iPhone 16 (all models)
  • iOS 18.3 or later
  • A supported carrier
  • A supported cellular plan in the case of some carriers

How does T-Mobile’s Starlink satellite feature work?

T-Mobile’s Starlink satellite feature makes your iPhone directly connect to the Starlink satellite network when it is in a location where the traditional cellular network isn’t available. As soon as your iPhone detects no signal from the cell tower, it will automatically switch to satellite mode and display “SAT” in the status bar.

What Starlink support means for iPhone users, and how it’s different from Globalstar

Apple already provides satellite connectivity on iPhones (starting with iPhone 14) through its partnership with Globalstar. However, there are key differences between it and the one offered by Starlink. Let’s check them out.

Automatic vs. manual connection:

  • Unlike Globalstar, Starlink does not require you to manually point your iPhone upwards toward the sky, as the connectivity is automatically established in the background. This means Starlink automatically connects your iPhone to satellites in remote areas with no cellular coverage.
  • Globalstar requires you to manually align your iPhone with a satellite by holding it toward the sky.

Availability and network size:

  • Being a subsidiary of Elon Musk’s SpaceX, Starlink has no dearth of satellites. It has a much larger satellite constellation than Globalstar, which enables it to offer better coverage and connection speeds.
  • Globalstar has fewer satellites, and obstructions like trees, hills, or buildings could interfere with connectivity.

Use cases:

  • Starlink currently supports messaging and is expected to expand support for calls and data.
  • Apple’s Globalstar connectivity was initially limited to emergency SOS but now supports iMessage, SMS, Find My Updates, and roadside assistance.

T-Mobile’s Starlink satellite service: Pricing

T-Mobile has made its Starlink satellite service free until July for all approved beta testers, irrespective of the carrier service they are subscribed to. Here’s what the pricing will look like once the free period ends in July, as per T-Mobile’s official press release:

  • T-Mobile customers with Go5G Next or eligible plans: Free
  • T-Mobile customers on other plans: $15 per month per line
  • Users on AT&T, Verizon, or other carriers: $20 per month per line
  • Early beta sign-ups (before the end of February): $10 per month (starting in July)

This tiered pricing structure makes Starlink a more affordable option for T-Mobile’s premium customers, while still allowing non-T-Mobile users to access the feature.

How to use Starlink satellite connectivity on iPhone

You don’t need to do anything extra if you fulfill the pre-requisites and have successfully enrolled in T-Mobile’s Starlink beta, as your iPhone will automatically switch to satellite mode and connect to Starlink satellite every time the cellular service is unavailable in a remote area. 

How to disable Starlink support on iPhone

While T-Mobile’s Starlink feature currently requires you to enroll in a beta program, the service will be available to all eligible users after the beta testing ends. But no matter how useful and tempting this carrier-based Starlink satellite connectivity may sound, some users might prefer not to use it for obvious privacy concerns.

If you are among such iPhone users, you can easily disable this carrier-based satellite support. Here’s how you can do this:

  1. Open Settings and head to Celluar.
  2. Select your carrier or phone number.
  3. Toggle off Satellite.

Once done, your iPhone will no longer connect to carrier-based satellite networks like Starlink.

Signing off…

All in all, T-Mobile’s Starlink Satellite connectivity provides an easier and automatic way to send and receive messages when you are in an area with no cellular coverage. Besides this, T-Mobile already has plans to expand this service to calls and mobile data soon. This will make satellite connectivity a game-changer for iPhone users who frequently travel off the grid.

Are you interested in using Starlink connectivity on your iPhone? Do share your thoughts in the comments.
